Description:
Job Summary
DE NCLC Manager - Technology Consulting
EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant Senior with strong subject matter expertise in SharePoint, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex modernization. The role will lead teams delivering large Microsoft 365 migration and modernization programs for clients across regions.
Your key responsibilities
Lead Microsoft 365 migration and modernization projects across SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, workflows and forms.
Provide technical leadership for SharePoint Online, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations, Nintex and Power Platform.
Define the delivery approach, estimates, migration waves, resourcing, governance and quality controls.
Lead assessments, identify risks and dependencies, and develop practical migration roadmaps.
Guide migration factory setup, pilots, wave execution, cutover and transition.
Oversee Nintex workflow and form modernization using Nintex Automation Cloud or Power Platform.
Review solution designs, migration plans, remediation approaches and deployment documents.
Lead delivery teams, remove blockers, monitor progress and maintain quality.
Manage client, security, Microsoft and vendor stakeholders, decisions and dependencies.
Support proposals, demonstrations, estimates, staffing plans and executive presentations.
Promote reusable methods, automation and continuous improvement.
Ensure compliance with security, quality, organizational and commercial requirements.
Skills and attributes
4-7 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
Strong SME-level knowledge of SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server, SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell and Microsoft 365 architecture.
Proven experience planning and delivering large Microsoft 365 migration programs involving SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
Experience with migration assessment, remediation, migration factory operations, wave planning, velocity management, cutover and hypercare.
Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.
Good to have Skills
Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.
Relevant Microsoft, Nintex, project management or agile certifications.
Soft Skills
Ability to lead, motivate and develop high-performing teams across locations.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
Ability to balance quality, timelines and cost.
Sound decision-making and problem-solving in complex situations.
Ability to manage scope, schedules, risks, quality and competing priorities.
Collaborative leadership with clear accountability for outcomes.
Ability to review technical deliverables, challenge assumptions and guide consultants and engineers.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelors or masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, preferably in a professional services or consulting organization.
Strong Microsoft 365 and SharePoint migration or modernization expertise.
Proven experience leading teams and delivering complex technology engagements.
Experience developing estimates, delivery plans, governance and stakeholder communications.
Ideally, you ll also have
Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
Led large-scale Microsoft 365 migration or modernization projects from discovery through transition.
Managed multidisciplinary teams covering migration, development, workflow modernization, testing and change activities.
Contributed to proposals, solutioning, capability development and client relationship growth.

Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators
Planning and monitoring of the project deliverables from the team.

Experience in Property & Casualty Insurance

Excellent business communication skills
Excellent leadership skills
Prior Client facing experience

Preferred Skills
Experience in Guidewire ClaimCenter Configuration
Experience in Insurance domain, preferably in Property & Casualty.

About the Opportunity
A growing technology consultancy in the Digital Transformation & Low-Code Automation sector, we help enterprises modernize legacy systems, streamline customer journeys, and accelerate business agility using Pega s end-to-end decisioning and workflow automation platform. Our architects design scalable, compliant, and cloud-ready Pega solutions that power mission-critical operations across BFSI, Healthcare, and Telecom verticals.
Role & Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end Pega solution design-from discovery & requirement mapping to LSA/SSA-level architecture and deployment.
Architect scalable, secure, and maintainable Pega applications using best practices for case types, data models, rulesets, and integrations.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate complex operational workflows into Pega-based automation using DCO and Agile methodologies.
Optimize performance, manage technical debt, and enforce architecture governance across multi-team Pega delivery programs.
Mentor junior developers and system architects; lead code reviews, technical spikes, and architecture decision logs (ADLs).
Integrate Pega with external systems (CRM, ERP, RPA, REST/SOAP APIs) and design robust error handling, auditing, and monitoring frameworks.
Skills & Qualifications
Must-Have
Pega Certified Senior System Architect (CSSA)
Pega Certified Lead System Architect (CLSA)
PegaRULES Process Commander (PRPC)
Pega Decisioning & AI Studio
Integration with REST/SOAP APIs
DevOps & CI/CD for Pega (Jenkins, Git, Docker)
Pega Cloud or Pega Infinity deployments
Data Pages, Decision Trees, and Service Levels
Preferred
Experience with Pega Customer Service or Pega Sales Automation
Knowledge of Pega Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
Exposure to Microservices architecture with Pega
Benefits & Culture Highlights
Work on cutting-edge enterprise automation projects with global clients
Flexible career growth path with mentorship from Pega Masters
On-site collaborative culture with regular technical deep dives and innovation labs

Description:
Role Overview
The Area Sales Manager (ASM) will be responsible for driving B2B sales growth within the assigned territory by managing and mentoring a team of Business Development Executives (BDEs). The role focuses on retailer acquisition, retention, order growth, relationship management, and execution excellence on the Superstore by Nykaa platform.
Key Responsibilities
1. Sales & Revenue Growth
Drive territory-wise revenue targets and ensure achievement of monthly/quarterly sales goals.
Increase retailer onboarding and active buyer base on the Superstore platform.
Improve order frequency and average order value (AOV).
Identify high-potential markets and expansion opportunities.
2. Team Management & Development
Manage, train, and mentor the team of Business Development Executives (BDEs) within the assigned territory.
Set clear KPIs and performance expectations for BDEs.
Conduct regular field visits and joint sales calls to guide the team.
Motivate BDEs to meet and exceed targets.
3. Retailer Acquisition & Relationship Management
Travel within the assigned territory to onboard new retailers.
Support BDEs in acquiring and activating new retailers.
Build long-term relationships with key retailers to ensure retention and repeat business.
Address retailer concerns and coordinate with internal teams for resolution.
Collect market intelligence and competitor insights.
4. Sales Execution & Process Implementation
Implement structured sales processes to help BDEs identify and prioritize key accounts and prospects.
Monitor team performance metrics (coverage, productivity, conversion rates).
Ensure proper usage and adoption of the Superstore app among retailers.
Drive promotional campaigns and new product launches in the territory.
5. Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
Provide regular sales performance reports to senior management.
Share customer feedback, demand trends, and improvement suggestions.
Maintain accurate sales data and territory records.

Description:
Group Company: JSW Steel Limited
Designation: Area Incharge-Mechanical
Job Brief: JSW Steel Limited is seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to lead the mechanical operations within the Pellet Plant department. This role demands a strategic and hands-on leader responsible for overseeing the maintenance, reliability, and performance of all mechanical equipment and systems in the pellet plant. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to optimize plant productivity. This position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, mechanical engineering principles, and team leadership within a heavy industrial environment.
Responsibilities:
Lead and manage the mechanical maintenance team to ensure optimal performance and reliability of pellet plant machinery and equipment.
Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to minimize downtime and extend equipment life.
Coordinate with production and quality teams to align mechanical operations with plant production goals and quality standards.
Monitor and analyze mechanical equipment performance data to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.
Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols and regulatory compliance within the mechanical department.
Manage budgeting, procurement, and inventory control for mechanical spare parts and tools.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on mechanical efficiency, cost reduction, and process optimization.
Oversee root cause analysis of mechanical failures and lead troubleshooting efforts to prevent recurrence.
Mentor and develop mechanical engineering staff, fostering a culture of technical excellence and teamwork.
Collaborate with engineering and project teams on equipment upgrades, installations, and modifications.
Skills:
Mechanical Equipment Maintenance
Predictive and Preventive Maintenance
Root Cause Analysis
Team Leadership and Development
Budgeting and Cost Control
Safety and Regulatory Compliance
Performance Monitoring and Data Analysis
Project Management
Process Optimization
Inventory and Spare Parts Management
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; a Masters degree is preferred.
Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in mechanical maintenance and operations within the steel manufacturing or heavy industrial sector.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
The position is accountable for proactively soliciting and handling sales opportunities. Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives. Achieves personal sales goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Position Overview
We are looking for an energetic and result-oriented Sales Representative to develop sales and distribution in the assigned territory.
The candidate will be responsible for appointing and developing Stockists/Distributors, generating Primary & Secondary Sales, increasing retail coverage, opening new outlets, and achieving monthly sales targets.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop potential Stockists / Distributors in the assigned territory.
Assist in appointment and activation of new Stockists/Distributors.
Generate Primary Sales from Stockists/Distributors as per assigned targets.
Drive Secondary Sales through regular retailer and market visits.
Visit retailers, wholesalers and dealers according to the assigned beat plan.
Generate regular orders from existing and new retail outlets.
Open new retail outlets and increase numerical distribution in the territory.
Ensure availability and visibility of company products at retail outlets.
Develop new markets, towns and sales opportunities within the assigned area.
Build strong relationships with Stockists, Distributors, Wholesalers and Retailers.
Ensure adequate stock availability with Stockists/Distributors.
Implement company schemes, promotions and new product launches in the market.
Monitor competitor products, pricing, schemes and market activities.
Follow up with distributors for orders, supplies and payments where required.
Maintain daily market visit, order booking and sales reports.
Achieve monthly Primary Sales, Secondary Sales, Outlet Coverage and New Outlet Opening targets.
Candidate Profile
* Experience: fresh or 1-2 years in Field Sales / General Trade / Distribution Sales.
* Experience in FMCG / Food / Consumer Products / General Trade preferred.
* Good understanding of Primary and Secondary Sales.
* Experience in retailer/dealer development and stockist handling preferred.
* Good knowledge of the local market and surrounding areas.
* Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Target-oriented and willing to travel extensively in the assigned territory.
* Candidate should be comfortable with daily field visits.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will primarily be measured on:
* Primary Sales Achievement
* Secondary Sales Achievement
* New Stockist / Distributor Development
* New Outlet Opening
* Productive Calls / Daily Market Coverage
* Retailer Order Generation
* Product Availability & Visibility
* Achievement of Monthly Sales Targets

JOB DESCRIPTION
District Head Land Acquisition | Industrial Project
Project

Industrial Project
Function

Land Acquisition / Project Development
Experience

15-20 Years of Relevant Experience
Location

Assigned District / Project Location
Reporting

State Head - Land Acquisition
Role Focus

Land Acquisition, District Management & Stakeholder Management

LAND ACQUISITION • DISTRICT MANAGEMENT • GOVERNMENT LIAISON • STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT
1. Role Overview
The District Head - Land Acquisition will be responsible for leading, managing and monitoring all land acquisition and land readiness activities within the assigned district for the Industrial Project. The role covers district level execution of land identification and sourcing, private and government land acquisition, title verification and due diligence, revenue documentation, statutory approvals, government liaisoning, stakeholder management, negotiations and timely possession/handover of required land parcels. The District Head will lead and coordinate the district land acquisition team, including Project Leads and Project Support personnel, and act as the key interface between the State Head, client/project teams, landowners, local stakeholders, legal teams, consultants and District/Revenue Authorities.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Land Identification, Sourcing & Acquisition
Lead and monitor end to end land identification, sourcing, aggregation and acquisition activities across the assigned district.
Prepare and monitor district wise and village wise land acquisition plans in line with project requirements and timelines.
Ensure identification of suitable land parcels, preparation of land schedules, identification of landowners and plotting of required land on village/revenue maps.
Manage acquisition of private and government land through applicable State policies, revenue/allotment processes, LARR, surface rights, industrial development authorities or other applicable mechanisms.
Monitor parcel wise land aggregation, including area, ownership, acquisition status, documentation, possession and pending requirements.
Monitor private, government and other project relevant land processes applicable within the district.
B. Title Verification, Due Diligence & Legal Coordination
Oversee title verification and land due diligence covering ownership records, revenue records, encumbrances, disputes, transferability and other title related matters.
Coordinate with Legal teams and consultants for Title Search Reports (TSRs), legal opinions, agreements and resolution of title related issues.
Ensure proper collection, maintenance and updating of land documents, approvals, correspondence, agreements, survey records and other project documentation.
Ensure acquisition activities comply with applicable legal requirements, approved commercial parameters and project timelines.
C. Government Liaisoning, Revenue & Statutory Approvals
Liaise and maintain effective working relationships with District Administration, Collectorate, Revenue Authorities, Tehsil offices and other relevant Government Departments.
Monitor statutory permissions, land-use requirements, revenue permissions and project related approvals.
Develop and maintain relationships with District Administration, Revenue Authorities, local bodies, landowners and key local stakeholders.
Coordinate with relevant authorities and internal teams on revenue documentation, record entries, permissions and other district level land matters.
D. Landowner Negotiations, Stakeholder Management & Handover
Lead and support negotiations with landowners and other stakeholders regarding land rates, transaction terms and other commercial conditions within approved parameters.
Handle landowner, stakeholder, documentation, revenue and coordination issues at district level, escalating material matters to the State Head.
Ensure post-allotment/acquisition activities, including measurement, demarcation, revenue record entries and possession/handover of land parcels, are completed.
Ensure required land parcels are handed over to the client/project team within agreed timelines and in accordance with project requirements.
Anticipate district level risks, local issues and stakeholder concerns that may affect acquisition timelines and initiate appropriate corrective action.
E. Project Coordination, Mapping & Progress Reporting
Coordinate with Survey, Project, Legal, Compliance, Documentation, Administration and other internal teams for timely execution.
Review land acquisition progress against project milestones and identify delays, bottlenecks and critical dependencies.
Monitor the use of Google Earth, maps, satellite imagery and revenue/village maps for land identification, access assessment and parcel tracking.
Coordinate land requirements relating to project infrastructure, access, utilities, connectivity and ancillary facilities.
Conduct regular field visits and review the progress of Project Leads and field teams.
Prepare and submit periodic MIS, district level land acquisition reports, risk reports and progress updates to the State Head/Management.
Ensure land acquisition and land readiness activities remain aligned with the project's development and implementation schedule.
F. District Level Management & Team Leadership
Take overall ownership of land acquisition activities within the assigned district.
Allocate villages, clusters and land parcels among Project Leads/field teams and monitor their performance.
Lead, guide and monitor Project Leads, Project Support personnel and other field resources deployed within the district.
Set clear acquisition targets and timelines for the district team.
Review team performance, field activities, pending cases and documentation status regularly.
Guide team members in resolving landowner, revenue, documentation and local stakeholder issues.
Ensure effective coordination and communication between field teams and State/Head Office functions.
Ensure discipline, accountability and accurate reporting within the district land acquisition team.
Conduct periodic reviews with Project Leads and Project Support teams to ensure targets, documentation and timelines are achieved.
Provide accurate district level information to the State Head for management/client reviews and decision-making.
G. Authority, Accountability & Risk Escalation
Act as the primary district level authority for day-to-day land acquisition and land readiness activities.
Represent the project for routine coordination with district level authorities, landowners and other stakeholders.
Take appropriate operational decisions within approved commercial, legal and organisational parameters.
Escalate significant legal, commercial, regulatory, political/local stakeholder and project risks to the State Head.
Remain accountable for district wise land acquisition targets, documentation completeness and timely possession/handover of land.
3. Required Experience & Qualifications
8-12 years of relevant experience in Land Acquisition, Land Aggregation, Industrial Projects, Infrastructure, Energy, Real Estate or a closely related field.
Graduate qualification in Law, Engineering, Management, Commerce or another relevant discipline.
Strong hands on experience in managing land acquisition at district/project level.
Experience dealing directly with District Administration, Revenue Authorities, landowners, consultants and project stakeholders.
Practical experience in private and government land acquisition, title verification, due diligence, revenue documentation and statutory processes.
Demonstrated experience in landowner negotiations and resolution of complex land related issues.
Experience in leading and managing field based land acquisition teams.
Working knowledge of applicable State land/revenue framework and local acquisition environment.
4. Core Skills & Competencies
Land Acquisition & Aggregation
District Level Land Acquisition Management
Private & Government Land Processes
Title Verification & Due Diligence
Revenue Records & Land Documentation
Government Liaisoning & Statutory Approvals
District Administration Coordination
Landowner & Stakeholder Management
Commercial & Landowner Negotiation
Team Leadership & Performance Management
Survey, Demarcation & Field Coordination
Google Earth / Map Based Site Assessment
Risk Identification & Problem Solving
MIS, Documentation & Progress Reporting
Strong Communication & Negotiation Skills
Working knowledge of the local language and local land/acquisition environment (preferred)
Languages: English, Hindi and Local Language (preferred)
5. Key Success Measures
The District Head - Land Acquisition will be expected to ensure that the required land parcels within the assigned district are identified, legally and commercially assessed, acquired through applicable processes, properly documented and handed over in accordance with agreed project timelines.
Success will be measured through achievement of district-wise land acquisition targets, timely resolution of land and stakeholder issues, effective government liaisoning, accuracy and completeness of land documentation, performance of the district land team and timely possession/handover of encumbrance free land required for uninterrupted project execution.

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Description:
Functions as the strategic business leader of property operations and acts as General Manager in his/her absence.
Areas of responsibility include Front Office, , Retail/Gift Shops, Recreation/Fitness Center, Housekeeping, Security/Loss Prevention, Engineering/Maintece, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Event Management, where applicable.
Position works with direct reports (Executive Committee members and department heads) to develop and implement the operations strategy and ensuring implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
The position ensuring operations meet the brand s target customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes ficial performance.
As a member of the Executive Committee, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Profitability and Departmental Budgets
- Keeps operations team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired ficial results.
- Ensures that all operational areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.
- Reviews ficial reports and statements to determine how Operations is performing against budget.
- Ensures capital expenditure funds are being used to address the priorities outlined in the service strategy.
- Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establishing ways to improve the departments ficial performance.
- Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.
- Identifies and analyzes operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
- Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.
- Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holds team accountable for results.
- Develops an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand s business strategy and leads its execution.
- Makes and executes key decisions to keep property moving forward towards achievement of goals.
Managing Property Operations
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding operational goals to produce desired results on a continuous basis.
- Ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
- Ensures core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.
- Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
Leading Property Operations Teams
- Establishes a vision for product and service delivery on property.
- Champions the brand s service vision for product and service delivery and ensuring alignment amongst the property leadership team.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Hires operations management team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
- Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
- Utilizes an open door policy and reviewing employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Stays knowledgeable of leadership talent in the property.
- Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. Location: Remote (India) - Bangalore Preferred
Job Type: Contract

1. Organization Management (OM)
Configure OM objects and infotypes.
Act as a functional consultant for OM-related developments.
Manage integrations of OM data with third-party systems.

Configure Personnel Areas, Subareas, and country-specific settings.
Handle ad-hoc queries and reporting configurations.

Configure wage types and work schedules across countries.

Monitor and support SAP Taleo integrations via Staffeto.
Ensure smooth data flow and troubleshoot integration issues.
Required Skills & Experience:
Strong experience in SAP HCM (ECC) with focus on OM and PA.
Basic/working knowledge of Payroll processes.
Experience in handling SAP integrations and third-party systems.
Exposure to Taleo integration (Staffeto) is preferred.
Good communication and problem-solving skills.

Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.

- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.

Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.

Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.

- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.

- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job description

Job Specification:-
Position:-Sales Officer
Location :-Baramula
Experience :- 1 years +
Industry:- Nutraceutical
Channel:- General Trade/Modern Trade

Job Description:- General Trade.
1. Sales Target Achievement: Daily market visit and cover 20-25 retailers daily basis as per monthly travel plan. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in General Trade by expanding the distributor and retailer base.
2. Distributor Management: Build strong relationships with distributors, ensuring product availability and maintaining optimum stock levels.
3. Retailer Engagement: Conduct regular market visits to assess retailer performance, manage relationships, and ensure visibility of the brand in outlets.
4. Route Planning: Plan and execute the sales route for daily market visits to maximize coverage and improve product penetration.
5. Market Feedback: Gather feedback from retailers and distributors on pricing, promotions, competitor activity, and product acceptance.

Modern Trade (MT):
Store Management: Work closely with key accounts, supermarkets, and hypermarkets to drive sales and ensure product visibility.
Planogram Compliance: Ensure the brands products are displayed according to planogram guidelines and that promotional displays are set up correctly.
Stock Management: Monitor stock levels in stores, coordinating with supply chain and merchandising teams to avoid out-of-stock situations.
Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with store managers, buyers, and category managers to ensure smooth operations.
Promotions & Activations: Implement promotional campaigns, in-store activations, and other initiatives to boost sales and brand awareness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Growth in the number of active retailers and stores.
Improvement in product visibility and brand presence in both GT and MT.
Effective distributor and store relationship management.
Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Area

Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
The Team Leader - ESSCO will spearhead the sales team s efforts to position Essco as a leading brand in the value market segment. This role requires strategic oversight and hands-on management to drive revenue growth across Essco s product lines, including faucets, sanitaryware, cisterns, and H.W.S. The Team Leader will take personal ownership of key Regional Distributors (RDs), ensure effective training of the sales team, and achieve substantial dealer growth. This role is pivotal in executing market strategies, enhancing dealer performance, and leading a high-performing team to meet and exceed targets.
Key Responsibilities
Sales Team Performance: Oversee and drive the performance of the Essco sales team to meet or exceed revenue targets across all product lines: ESSCO Faucets, ESSCO Sanitaryware, ESSCO Cisterns, and ESSCO H.W.S.
Key Account Management: Take personal ownership of select top RDs, ensuring they meet their sales targets and contribute to overall revenue performance
RSD Management: Manage and coordinate with Regional Sub-Distributors (RSDs) to ensure alignment with sales strategies and optimal performance
RD Recruitment & Selection: Identify and recruit suitable Regional Distributors (RDs) in consultation with the HOD/ZH
Dealer Growth: Drive dealer growth, ensuring a minimum of 85% of the dealer universe shows measurable expansion and increased productivity
Sales Team Training: Conduct and oversee targeted training sessions for the RD/RDS sales team to enhance their skills and performance, ensuring all training goals are met
Market Development: Develop and implement strategies to expand Essco s market presence, including penetrating new markets and increasing the brand s footprint in existing areas
Performance Monitoring: Monitor and analyze sales performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions as needed
Dealer Relations: Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers to foster growth, resolve issues, and enhance dealer satisfaction
Reporting: Provide regular reports to senior management on sales performance, market trends, and team progress, including insights and recommendations for strategic adjustments
Operational Efficiency: Ensure efficient and effective execution of sales operations, including compliance with company policies, pricing strategies, and promotional activities
Brand Visibility and Hygiene: Maintain high standards of brand visibility and hygiene across all dealer showrooms and points of sale
Issue Resolution and Coordination: Address and resolve any issues related to supplies, sales policies, and customer care in coordination with the relevant departments
Market Analysis: Conduct market surveys and analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
Inventory Management: Ensure effective inventory management and supply chain operations to meet market demands
Promotional Activities: Lead the implementation of promotional activities and marketing campaigns to boost brand visibility and sales
Dealer and Customer Pipeline: Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of potential new dealers and customers
Compliance and Ethics: Ensure compliance with company policies and ethical standards in all business operations
OC & Factory Visits: Plan and facilitate visits to Orientation Centers (OCs) and the factory for potential external customers
Supply & Sales Issue Resolution: Address and resolve issues related to supplies, sales, and customer care for dealers and specifiers
Key Attributes
Proven ability to lead and motivate a sales team to achieve and exceed targets
Strong understanding of the building materials industry
Demonstrated success in managing key accounts and driving dealer growth
Effective training and development skills with a focus on enhancing team performance
Strategic thinking with the ability to implement tactical plans for market expansion and revenue growth
Strong analytical skills for monitoring performance and identifying improvement opportunities
Competencies
Customer Focus
Negotiation Skills
Presentation Skills
Competitor Analysis and Market Development
Qualifications and Experience
Education:
Bachelor s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field
An MBA or equivalent is preferred
Experience:
10-12 years of experience in sales within the building materials industry or a related sector
3-4 years of experience in a team leadership or managerial role, with a proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving team performance
Skills:
Excellent leadership and team management skills
Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
Proficiency in strategic planning and execution
Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to drive decision-making
Effective training and mentoring skills
Proactive problem-solving attitude and adaptability
Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills

Description:
The Assistant Manager - GIS (Government and Institutional Sales) focuses on educating government institutions about Jaquar s Complete Bathroom Solutions (CBS). The role involves specifying Bills of Quantity (BOQ) and mock-ups for projects, renewing agreements with existing GIS accounts, enlisting new GIS accounts, and ensuring prompt collections. The primary aim is to generate revenue by establishing and maintaining strong relationships with government institutions and enhance brand presence in the government sector.
Key Responsibilities
Educate key decision-makers, contractors, and trade customers of government institutions about CBS, including company vision, product details, USPs, and customer value
Establish all CBS verticals in GIS accounts and ensure specification in BOQ/mock-ups at the projects initial stages
Generate revenue from existing GIS accounts, renew approvals timely, and ensure zero account loss
Add new GIS accounts to the customer list and generate revenue from these new accounts
Maintain price discipline with GIS accounts to ensure no financial loss to the company
Introduce and promote newly launched products by the company to key stakeholders in government institutions
Maintain good rapport with channel partners for fast execution of orders and mockups
Identify and target specific projects for the promotion of new products, ensuring their inclusion in project specifications
Secure BOQ (Bill of Quantities) and Mock-up approvals for identified projects, ensuring new products are specified at the initial stages
Conduct presentations for key decision-makers, trade customers, and contractors at the Orientation Center and plant
Provide support to government departments, resolving issues, including customer care concerns
Build relationships with government institutions, maintain a directory of government officials, and distribute gifts on specific occasions
Ensure no collections are pending with government institutions beyond 45 days of billing
Conduct at least 180 productive meetings monthly with external customers
Generate CBS revenue from government institutions
Monitor and keep track of competitors activities
Ensure the consolidation of the validity/longevity of the approvals enlistments and specifications got done so far in the Central/State/PSUs Others
Add more new departments to the existing list by identifying and carrying out a similar exercise as has been done for approval enlistment
Provide data on time to HO and ensure the same from the respective team members
Update database from all the departments on the officials, their designation, office etc. for best use of it
Key Attributes
Prior experience in institutional sales
Expertise in market development
Familiarity with government institutions working processes
A well-established network of government officials
Strong product knowledge
Experience in independently handling clients
Proficiency in securing approvals with government institutions
Well acquainted with order processing process
Competencies
Customer Focus
Negotiation Skills
Presentation Skills
Competitor Analysis and Market Development

Education:
Graduate / MBA
Technical qualification preferred
Additional certifications in sales or marketing are a plus
Experience:
5 to 7 Years of experience in sales within the building materials industry or a related sector
Relevant experience in government and institutional sales is preferable

Effective planning skills
Proactive approach
Strong ownership and accountability
Exceptional relationship-building abilities
Problem-solving
Excellent communication and convincing skills
Strong analytical ability
Resilience under work pressure
Team-oriented
Flexibility and adaptability
Negotiation skills

Description:
Ways of Working -

Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

About the Team -

Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!

Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.

Role Summary -

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month.

The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities -

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently. Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned. Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business. Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc. Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner. Interaction with

Stakeholders:

Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV) Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel -

Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Effective communication skills

Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life. Analytical, good Excel skills.

The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.

Initiative & Flexibility:

Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Creativity & Initiative:

Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

AboutCompany:
Axis Max Life Insurance, one of the leading non-bank promoted private life insurers, is a joint venture between Axis Max Services Ltd. and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co. Ltd. Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive long term savings, protection and retirement solutions through its high quality agency distribution and multi-channel distribution partners. A financially stable company with a strong track record over the last 20 years, Axis Max Life offers superior investment expertise. Axis Max Life has the vision 'To be the most admired life insurance company by securing the financial future of our customers'. The company has a strong customer-centric approach focused on advice-based sales and quality service delivered through its superior human capital.

During the financial year 2018-19, Axis Max Life achieved ‘Gross Written Premium’ of Rs. 14,575 crore & had sum assured in force of Rs. 7,03,972 Crore. As on 31st March 2019, the Company had Rs. 62,798 crore of AUM & a share capital including reserves & surplus of Rs. 2,767 crore. The Company has nearly 35 lakh customers serviced by its 12,082 employees & 48,522 agent advisors through 269 offices across the country.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.
Counsel prospective learners about upGrads programs, courses, eligibility, and career benefits.
Follow up with leads and convert prospective learners into enrolled students.
Achieve assigned monthly admission and revenue targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups and build strong relationships with prospective learners.
Handle queries and objections related to programs, fees, eligibility, and career outcomes.
Maintain accurate lead and conversion records in the CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission and enrollment process.

Requirements
0-3 years of experience in Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Admission Counseling, Telesales, or Business Development.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable learning programs.
Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.
Candidates from EdTech, Education, BFSI, Telecom, or other sales-driven industries are preferred.
AboutCompany:
About upGrad:
upGrad is an online education platform building the careers of tomorrow by offering the most industry-relevant programs in an immersive learning experience. AboutCompany:
IKS Health is the only integrated solution that enables enterprise healthcare organizations to achieve superior financial and clinical outcomes while also empowering them to grow successfully, operate efficiently, and navigate industry change.
