Description:
Web Developer - Full-Stack and Client Web Solutions (Job location - Agartala, Tripura, India)
Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.
Integrate forms, payment systems, APIs, analytics, third-party services, and other functionality where required.
2. Website Management & Maintenance
Take responsibility for the ongoing technical management of assigned client websites.
Perform regular CMS, WordPress, theme, plugin, and software updates.
Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, compatibility problems, and technical issues.
Maintain backups and website recovery procedures.
Monitor website functionality, availability, and performance.
Implement requested content, design, layout, and functionality changes.
Provide ongoing technical support for completed client projects.
3. Hosting, Domains & Technical Operations
Configure and manage domains, subdomains, DNS records, and nameservers.
Manage website hosting environments, VPS servers, cPanel/WHM, and cloud-hosting platforms.
Configure and maintain SSL certificates.
Configure professional and business email services where required.
Perform website migrations, deployments, staging, backups, and restorations.
Troubleshoot hosting and server-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation for client projects.
4. Website Security & Performance
Implement website security best practices.
Conduct routine website security checks.
Identify and resolve vulnerabilities and security-related issues.
Assist with malware prevention/removal and unauthorized-access incidents.
Optimize website loading speed and overall performance.
Configure caching, CDN, database optimization, image optimization, and related performance technologies.
Maintain appropriate website backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
5. Client & Project Coordination
Understand and document client requirements.
Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, phone calls, email, and approved digital channels.
Participate in client meetings and project discussions when required.
Provide project updates and coordinate revisions.
Maintain project timelines and ensure timely completion and delivery.
Handle multiple website development and maintenance assignments.
Maintain professional records of requirements, changes, project progress, and deliverables.
6. Project Procurement & Business Development
Identify prospective clients and new website-development opportunities.
Assist DSCHOLAR WEB in acquiring website design, development, hosting, maintenance, and related digital projects.
Communicate the services and solutions offered by DSCHOLAR WEB to prospective clients.
Develop professional networks and business relationships capable of generating projects.
Follow up with prospective clients and business leads where assigned.
Participate in organizational business-development initiatives.
Performance Incentive: Attractive additional performance-based incentives will be provided for eligible projects successfully procured by the employee, subject to organizational terms and policies.
7. Training & Mentorship
Conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and practical classes when assigned.
Train interested candidates and team members in website development and related technologies.
Provide practical training in WordPress, website development, hosting, domains, and web operations.
Prepare technical documentation and training materials where required.
Mentor trainees and provide guidance during practical web-development activities.
8. Daily Desk-Based Responsibilities
As this is a full-time desk job based in Agartala, Tripura, the selected employee will be expected to:
Maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Remain available for assigned responsibilities throughout designated working hours.
Work independently as well as collaboratively with the team.
Attend internal meetings, client discussions, training sessions, and project reviews.
Maintain daily or periodic records of assigned and completed work when required.
Coordinate professionally with management, colleagues, clients, and trainees.
Meet project deadlines and assigned performance expectations.
Maintain professional workplace conduct and discipline.
Handle multiple assignments efficiently in a professional desk-based environment.
Required Qualifications
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Professional Experience: Preferably 1-5 years of relevant web-development experience, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Portfolio: Candidates should be able to demonstrate their technical abilities through a portfolio, live websites, GitHub projects, previous professional work, or practical technical assessment.
Required Technical Skills
JavaScript / TypeScript, PHP and/or Node.js, WordPress, Elementor, MySQL / PostgreSQL, Responsive Web Design, UI/UX Fundamentals, Website Deployment, Domain and DNS Management, cPanel / WHM, VPS and Cloud Hosting, SSL Configuration, Website Migration and Backups, Website Security, Website Speed and Performance Optimization, Git / Version-Control Fundamentals.
Knowledge of React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, AWS, Vercel, Cloudflare, headless CMS platforms, APIs, e-commerce platforms, payment-gateway integrations, and related modern web technologies will be an advantage.
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate professionally with clients.
Good networking and interpersonal skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
Strong time-management and organizational abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively as part of a professional team.
Ability to train and mentor others.
Professional discipline, punctuality, and accountability.
Candidates with strong networking, communication, and client-acquisition skills will be preferred.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: Negotiable based on the candidate s qualifications, relevant experience, portfolio, technical expertise, interview performance, and technical assessment.
Performance Incentives: Additional incentives may be provided for successfully procured and eligible client projects in accordance with organizational policy.
Work Environment: Professional, collaborative, and technology-focused environment with exposure to website development, hosting, digital operations, client projects, research-related platforms, and modern web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Application screening.
CV and portfolio evaluation.
Shortlisting.
Interview.
Technical assessment and/or practical web-development task.
Final selection.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for the interview/selection process.
Candidates demonstrating strong technical expertise, professional communication skills, independent project-handling ability, and good networking skills will be preferred.
Important
This vacancy is for a FULL-TIME, DESK-BASED POSITION IN AGARTALA, TRIPURA.
Candidates should apply only if they are available to work full-time in Agartala, Tripura and can maintain regular attendance, professional discipline, and availability during assigned working hours.

URGENT HIRING - CONSULTANT ANAESTHESIOLOGIST
Location: Kailashahar, Unakoti District, Tripura
Hospital Type: Multi-Speciality Hospital
POSITION
Consultant Anaesthesiologist - OT & ICU
QUALIFICATION
- MD Anaesthesiology
- DNB Anaesthesiology
- DA (Diploma in Anaesthesia)
- Valid NMC / Tripura State Medical Council Registration
EXPERIENCE
- Experienced candidates preferred
- Candidates with hands-on OT and ICU experience will be given preference
SALARY
3.5 Lakhs - 4 Lakhs per Month
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Conduct pre-operative anaesthesia assessment and evaluate surgical fitness
- Administer general, regional and other appropriate anaesthesia techniques
- Provide anaesthesia support for elective and emergency surgeries
- Monitor patients throughout surgical procedures and ensure safe peri-operative care
- Manage airway and intubation, including emergency airway situations
- Provide post-operative pain management and recovery care
- Support ICU management of critically ill patients in coordination with the treating team
- Assist with ventilator management and hemodynamic stabilization as required
- Respond to OT, ICU and hospital emergencies
- Coordinate with surgeons, physicians, intensivists, OT staff and nursing teams
- Maintain accurate anaesthesia records and clinical documentation
- Follow infection-control, patient-safety and hospital protocols
SKILLS REQUIRED
- Strong clinical knowledge of Anaesthesia and peri-operative care
- Good airway management and emergency response skills
- OT and ICU experience preferred
- Knowledge of ventilator and critical care management
- Good clinical decision-making and teamwork skills
- Professional and patient-centric approach
JOB TYPE
- Full-Time Consultant
- OT & ICU Responsibilities
BENEFITS
- Attractive compensation package
- Good OT and ICU clinical exposure
- Supportive multidisciplinary team
- Long-term professional growth opportunity
Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with current salary, expected salary, notice period and relevant OT/ICU experience.
Immediate joiners will be preferred.

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).
Training & Mentorship: Conduct training sessions and workshops for internal team members and interested candidates looking to upgrade their web development skills.
Technical Operations: Manage web hosting, domains, SSL, CMS platforms, and client delivery workflows.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
Experience: 1 5 years of web development experience building and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Core Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP/Node.js, and popular frameworks (React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js).
CMS & Database Management: Experience with WordPress/Elementor, headless CMS tools, and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Web Operations: Solid understanding of domain configuration, cloud hosting (AWS, Vercel, cPanel), SSL certificates, and web security best practices.
Work From Home (WFH) Setup Requirements
As a fully remote position, the candidate must have a functional and dedicated home workstation equipped with:
Hardware: High-performance laptop/desktop (Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7, minimum 16GB RAM, 256GB+ SSD).
Display & Peripherals: External monitor setup recommended for multi-tasking, along with a working webcam, noise-canceling headset, and microphone for video meetings.
Internet Connectivity: High-speed broadband connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a secondary backup power connection (e.g., router UPS or mobile hotspot) to ensure uninterrupted service during power outages.
Workspace: A quiet, professional home office space conducive to video calls with clients and trainees.
Compensation & Perks
Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.
Work Environment: e-Workspace, Collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to international clients and cutting-edge web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for an interview.
Candidates with good networking skills will be preferred.
Job Features
Job Category: Consultant, DScholar Web
Location: Remote
Work setup: Work from Home, Set-up required
Mode of Selection: Online Video Interview

CBM India Trust is committed to improving the quality of life of persons with disabilities and members of other marginalized communities. We work in partnership with local, national, and international actors with the aim of creating a more equal society for all. Our vision is to have an inclusive world in which all persons with disabilities enjoy their human rights and achieve their full potential. To ensure smooth field implementation, coordination with schools and communities, and quality delivery of inclusive education and accessibility interventions at the grassroots level.


Responsibilities
Field Operations Activity Planning
Lead planning and scheduling of field activities across program components and outcomes.
Coordinate day-to-day implementation of project activities in schools and communities.
Ensure timely execution of field plans and support the Project Manager with progress updates.
Coordinate with school authorities, block officials, and contractors for the renovation of
Oversee installation of accessibility features such as ramps, accessible toilets, railings, and
Ensure all modifications meet disability-inclusive accessibility standards.
Training Capacity - Building Coordination
Organize and coordinate training for teachers, special educators, and school staff.
Manage training logistics, including scheduling, venue coordination, materials, and
Support implementation of inclusive education practices promoted under Samagra Shiksha.
Community Field Team Supervision
Supervise Community Mobilizers and ensure effective outreach and engagement across all
Guide field teams in community awareness, school engagement, and inclusion activities.
Ensure consistent program coverage and quality implementation at the grassroots level.
Therapy Services Child Support
Coordinate with therapy centers to facilitate services for children with disabilities.
Arrange transport and support mechanisms to ensure regular access to therapy services.
Track participation and follow-up of children receiving therapy and educational support.
Monitor field progress and document implementation challenges.
Prepare regular updates and structured field reports for the Project Manager.
Support data collection and reporting for program monitoring and donor reporting
Ensure adherence to disability-inclusive standards in all school-level interventions.


Professional profile and requirements
A Bachelor's degree in Education, Social Work, Disability Studies, or a related field, or a B.Ed. in Special Education, or a Diploma in Special Education
2-3 years of experience in field coordination or program implementation in education, rehabilitation, or community development projects.
Prior experience working on inclusive education or programs for children with disabilities under initiatives such as Samagra Shiksha will be preferred.
Experience coordinating with schools, community stakeholders, and local government officials in


Skills
Strong coordination and communication skills for effective stakeholder engagement, including school interactions, home visits, and community sensitization on disability inclusion.
Proficiency in basic digital tools for monitoring and reporting, including Excel and mobile-based applications for IEP tracking and program data management.
Willingness to travel extensively across districts in Tripura, with strong cultural sensitivity to disability inclusion and community norms.


Other requirements
The future job holder is expected to adhere to CBM India\'s policies and procedures, commit to CBM India\'s Child Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct, and follow CBM India\'s safety security.

Description:
Job Purpose
The responsibility of this role is to plan, implement and achieve the sales targets for the branch by developing channels like Banking, National Distributors and IFAs for central & harbor suburbs through distributor engagement & expansion.
Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context/Job Challenges:Organisation ContextEstablished in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group &Sunlife Ficial Inc. , a leading international ficial services company in Canada. ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds ¤tly ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 2 Lakh 45 Thousand crores(as on Nov 2017). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM &5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of November 2017, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10. 73%. The company grew its investor client base by 44% to about 5. 2 Mn from 3. 6 Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category. Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in more than 200 locations across the country with approx 65, 000 IFAs, 210 National Distributors & 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai & Mauritius. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. The Company follows a longterm, fundamental research based approach to investment &thrives to provide a transparent ðical services to its investors. One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic &constantly changing regulatory norms of the country &maintaining growth &profitability in the extremely competitive market. &some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain &grow are:
Focus on TechnologyThe organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation &also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors
Product InnovationABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products &has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Birla Cash plus, etc. Research based approachABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in. Strong Distributor Delivery MechanismThe Company has developed a 4pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach &penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Ficial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) &Banks.
Regulator InterfaceABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. It has hence ensured that it can discuss any new Industry development from a regulatory perspective at the initial stages with the Regulator as well as the Industry Association
People Management ABSLAMC believes in continuously measuring the perception of its people using a 4S approach, namely Satisfaction, Say, Stay &Strive, which has enabled it to garner a workforce committed &aligned to the overall business success. In context to the organization, the Banking Distribution, IFA &ND channels are a very integral &critical part of the Retail Distribution setup.
Plan, organize & manage all activities to drive Retail Sales through all the channels in the region to increase AUM, market share, quality &profit potential of assets. The Banking Distribution compromises of the Retail &Private Banks. As these retail channels cater to very different class &set of clients &client requirements, it gives us a platform to promote our diversified set of products based on these requirements.
Key Challenges for the role are as follows:
a)To ensure an increase in visibility activities.
b)Lack of a measurement tool for performance, thus the branch manager has to manually maintain &update performance data.
c)Difficulty of coordination with different channels of distribution
Key Result Areas KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters) Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters) KRA1 Retail Sales Execution Drives ongoing sales from the defined relationships and contribute towards regions achievements
Obtains and analyzes information from market to identify new clients, makes direct pitches, liaises with channel partners to increase sales
Profiles distributors and caters to their requirements to ensure ongoing business from them
Ensures targeted number of folios are added and achieves targeted amount of new SIPs KRA2 Retail Sales Execution
Distributor Empanelment & Engagement Conducts regular meetings and contact with the distributors
Undertakes empanelment and activation of distributors
Disseminates updates and other product related information in timely manner
Organizes and executes trainings and engagements for partners KRA3 Reporting and compliance Ensures 100% compliance with internal reporting & audit systems
Provides weekly reports to Regional Heads
Updates sales portal with requisite information to facilitate information collation and analysis
Undertakes installation of advertising and publicity materials for brand visibility KRA4 Branch Administration Ensure branch administration in order to help maintain and grow sales in the region.
Ensure good rating for the branch and get well equipped for internal audit.
Ensure compliance and SEBI code of conduct issues are adhered to KRA5 Overseeing Branch administration and monitoring branch issues to ensure a smooth delivery of service to clients Facilitate smooth operations of the branch including branch imprest, administration, operations and client servicing standards KRA6 Providing relevant reports to management for assigned territory. Furnishing relevant sales reports of the branch to Cluster & Zonal Head KRA7 Managing and monitoring team members for better productivity 1. Facilitating regular training, guidance and development of team members
2. Ensuring AMFI Certification of team members
3. Monitoring performance of RM s on monthly basis and take corrective measures if achievement deviates from the required achievements.

1. Position Details
Designation: Sales Officer
Location: South Tripura
Department: Trade Sales
Reporting To: ASM/TSM
Salary Range: As per market standards
Experience: 23 years in Sales / Channel Management
Qualification: Graduation (MBA / Marketing preferred)
2. Role Purpose
The Executive – Sales is responsible for driving business growth in the territory by managing dealer and sub-dealer networks, achieving sales and collection targets, strengthening market presence, and ensuring effective execution of company strategies.
3. Key Deliverables / Responsibilities
Manage and expand channel distribution
Appoint, develop, and monitor dealers and authorized sub-dealers
Achieve assigned primary and secondary sales targets
Ensure availability of products and correct market pricing
Execute brand-building and promotional activities at local level
Conduct mason/contractor meets and provide technical support
Ensure timely collection and healthy fund flow from dealers
Track competitor activity and provide market intelligence
Maintain accurate sales reports, MIS, and forecasts
4. Key Result Areas (KRA) & Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
KRA 1: Sales Target Achievement
Monthly, quarterly, and annual volume & value target achievement
Growth in secondary sales and repeat business
KRA 2: Channel Development
Appointment of new dealers and sub-dealers
Improvement in dealer productivity and coverage
KRA 3: Market Development & Visibility
Increased market share in Sivasagar region
Execution of branding, visibility, and promotional activities
KRA 4: Collection & Credit Control
Timely collection as per credit norms
Reduction of overdue and outstanding balances
KRA 5: Compliance & Reporting
Adherence to company pricing, schemes, and SOPs
Timely reporting of sales, collections, and market feedback
5. Roadmap of Success
0–3 Months
Understand company products, pricing, and sales processes
Map Sivasagar market, dealer base, and competitor landscape
Build strong relationships with dealers and influencers
3–6 Months
Achieve minimum 85–90% of assigned sales targets
Expand sub-dealer network in uncovered areas
Improve product visibility and secondary sales
6–12 Months
Consistently achieve or exceed targets
Strengthen dealer loyalty and market share
Become a key contributor to regional business growth
AboutCompany: We are driven by not just our core business of producing superior quality cement, but also the desire to create a positive impact in peoples lives, as well as the environment. Hence, along with world-class labs for quality control, we have a built-in, self-regulating mechanism to encourage a positive impact on the environment, employees, local communities and stakeholders. Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Job Description:
Central Medical Services Society (CMSS), (An autonomous body under Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India), is seeking a skilled and dedicated Junior Pharmacist on the payroll of LRS Services Pvt. Ltd. The ideal candidate will have experience in pharmaceutical storage, distribution, and regulatory compliance.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage pharmaceutical store/warehouse/distribution functions efficiently.
Ensure adherence to Good Storage and Distribution Practices (GSDP) in line with GMP regulations.
Support regulatory audits related to store/warehouse and distribution operations.
Maintain and update inventory records in the ERP system.

Age: Below 40 years as of the date of deployment (relaxation may be considered in exceptional cases).
Educational Qualification:
Diploma in Pharmacy (D. Pharma) or
Bachelor s Degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharma) from a recognized university/institute approved by the Pharmacy Council of India.

Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience for B. Pharma holders.
Skills and Knowledge:
Familiarity with Good Storage & Distribution Practices (GSDP) as per GMP regulations.
Experience in handling regulatory audits.
Proficiency in ERP systems.
Strong command of English (both written and verbal).
Knowledge of the local language is desirable.
Additional Information:
Candidates with exceptional qualifications or experience may receive age and experience relaxation. This is a dynamic role requiring attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to maintaining high pharmaceutical standards.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

SAP MDG
Data Governance
Data Quality Management
Data Replication
Data Validation
Material Master
Business Partner Master
Customer Master
Vendor Master
Financial Master Data
Good to Have
SAP Information Steward

SAP MDG on S/4HANA
Workflow Configuration
Business Rules Framework (BRF+)
Data Modeling
Master Data Consolidation
Data Cleansing
Data Harmonization
SAP S/4HANA Integration
Master Data Management Processes
SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience

The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Tech Lead (Backend Developer) - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will leverage advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets, helping solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing machine learning models to enhance data-driven decision-making processes
- Collaborating with client support teams to design and develop robust data solutions that drive business growth
- Utilizing data science algorithms and troubleshooting techniques to optimize data analysis and visualization
- Mentoring team members to leverage their unique strengths and improve performance on client engagements
- Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for comprehensive data solutions
- Taking ownership of projects, including planning, budgeting, execution, and completion, to meet client expectations
- Encouraging innovation and the use of technology to enhance delivery and inspire team development
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in challenging conversations with clients and stakeholders to maintain project alignment
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree from Tier 1
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Strong proficiency in Python for production-grade application or service development.
- Experience designing, implementing, and integrating REST APIs.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised service deployment.
Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including schema design, querying, and performance tuning.
- Proficiency with Git-based collaborative development workflows.
- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including clean code, automated testing, design patterns, and maintainability.
- Working knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience setting technical direction, reviewing code, resolving complex issues, and mentoring engineers.
- Experience with asynchronous APIs, messaging platforms, or event-streaming technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
- Exposure to agentic development using frameworks such as LangGraph, the OpenAI SDK, or Google ADK.
- Leveraging tools and methodologies to generate innovative solutions

Description:
Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.

You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work on exploratory and descriptive analysis, statistical modeling, and creating data visualizations to help solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions.

- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing data-driven strategies using machine learning, predictive modeling, and artificial intelligence
- Overseeing the creation and maintenance of data pipelines and data lakes to support large-scale data processing
- Collaborating with stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging data science to drive business growth
- Utilizing programming languages such as R and MATLAB to develop and refine data models and algorithms
- Promoting the use of innovative technologies and methodologies within data science teams
- Confirming data quality and integrity through rigorous data validation and troubleshooting processes
- Mentoring junior staff and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development within the team
- Engaging in strategic planning and execution to align data science projects with organizational goals

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 7 years of experience

- Utilizing machine learning and deep learning techniques effectively

- Applying natural language processing and neural network methodologies

Role: MLOps + AWS DevOps Engineer
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are looking for a talented MLOps + AWS DevOps Engineer with strong Python skills and hands-on experience in building, deploying, and maintaining machine learning solutions on AWS cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have expertise in MLOps, DevOps automation, cloud-native technologies, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end MLOps pipelines for model training, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
Deploy and manage ML models using AWS services such as SageMaker, EKS, ECS, Lambda, and S3.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or similar tools.
Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, CloudFormation, or other IaC tools.
Develop automation scripts and tools using Python.
Containerize applications using Docker and orchestrate workloads using Kubernetes/EKS.
Monitor cloud resources, applications, and ML models using CloudWatch, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Implement model versioning, data versioning, and experiment tracking using MLflow or similar tools.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Software Engineers to operationalize ML solutions.
Ensure security, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization of cloud infrastructure.

Description:
Join Synergy Accounting Services LLP and become part of a growing team providing accounting and finance services to real estate businesses in the US.

We're looking for someone who wants more than just a job in finance someone eager to learn, grow and build a long-term career with us. This is a hands-on role where you'll take ownership, solve real problems, improve processes and make a visible contribution to the team.

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Staff Accountant, you will manage the complete books of accounts for assigned US clients, from day-to-day transactions through the month-end close, and be a reliable point of contact for those clients.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Record financial transactions accurately and on time in accounting software (QuickBooks / Xero / Yardi)
Perform bank and credit card reconciliations
Accounts Payable – record vendor bills and process payments
Accounts Receivable – record customer invoices, apply payments and follow up on overdue invoices by email/phone
Complete the monthly close: reconcile and review books within prescribed deadlines
Review the books for accuracy and completeness, and flag issues proactively
Research and suggest solutions to accounting challenges faced by clients
Communicate directly with clients over email, chat and phone – share updates, request information and resolve queries promptly

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter or equivalent qualification in accounting
0–2 years of accounting experience (US accounting experience is a plus; freshers with strong fundamentals are welcome)
Good understanding of accrual-based accounting and US GAAP
Strong written and spoken English
Detail-oriented, with good organisational and time-management skills
Self-driven, able to work independently and committed to meeting deadlines
Flexibility during month-end close and client deadlines

WHAT WE OFFER
Hands-on exposure to US accounting and real estate clients
Training and mentoring from experienced team members
A clear growth path within a growing firm
Yearly performance bonus

JOB DETAILS
Location: Dalhousie, Kolkata – Work from office
Shift: Day shift
Employment type: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: As per industry standards

INTERVIEW PROCESS
Written accounting test, followed by a personal interview.

Respond and attend to guest repair requests.
Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintece issues.
Perform preventive maintece on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication.
Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines.
Carry equipment (eg, tools, radio).
Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings.
Maintain maintece inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed.
Communicate each day s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards.
Display basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building.
Perform all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area.
Test, troubleshoot and perform basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (eg, plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom items.
Program TVs and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory duties.
Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintece work.
Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers.
Display basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintece problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials.
Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation.
Adhere to quality expectations and standards.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees.
Speak with others using clear and professional language.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance.
Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Enter and locate work-related information using computers.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

Key responsibilities are assigned based on an evaluation of the candidates professional qualification, relevant SPA and Disputes experience, analytical skills, and a demonstrated working knowledge of transaction value drivers and post-deal issues. As a Senior Associate in the SPA & Disputes team, you will work on EV to Equity bridge analysis, post-deal mechanisms and disputes matters, while collaborating with PwC UK teams on project deliverables. Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Work in a team performing analytical procedures on accounting and financial data to support transaction value assessments, and visualising insights using Excel and AI tools (training will be provided on these tools); Interpret and critically review transaction legal documentation and evaluate completion accounts and locked box mechanisms, identifying areas of value leakage or risk; Identify areas which may warrant further investigation / give rise to potential adjustments to price; Proactively work with team leaders and team members to manage a workload of multiple projects with competing priorities based on relative importance and urgency; Communicating confidently with engagement teams to understand scope and expectations, and present project deliverables once they have been completed; Supporting engagement setup from initiation through to completion, understanding workflow management tools, relevant application of AI tools, and ensuring accurate documentation of work performed; Participate in a wide range of projects and collaborate across multiple workstreams or teams; consistently demonstrating creative thinking, individual initiative and timely completion of assigned work; and Consistently demonstrate teamwork dynamics by working as a team member: understand personal and team roles; contribute to a positive working environment by building solid relationships with team members; and proactively seek guidance, clarification and feedback.
Preferred Qualifications Strong interest in mergers and acquisitions, with the ability to understand key value drivers in transactions; Good knowledge of accounting fundamentals, price adjustment mechanics (e.g. net debt, working capital), and valuation principles; Familiarity with valuation methods and transaction mechanisms such as completion accounts and locked box structures; Demonstrated ability to analyse complex financial data and legal documents with precision; Proven track record of independently managing deliverables and maintaining high quality under tight deadlines; Effective written and verbal communication skills in English; Self-motivated, with a strong commitment to personal growth and continuous learning; and Adaptable and eager to develop new skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Basic Qualifications Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; Strong written and verbal communication skills; Certifications requirement: CA/MBA; Good accounting and financial concepts; High level of attention to detail; 2-5 years experience in analysing financial accounting information (for example in audit or FDD); and Awareness of business valuations concepts (Enterprise Value vs. Equity Value) and transaction mechanisms (completion accounts vs. locked box).

Experienced in Conceptual, Basic, FEED and Detailed Engineering phases of Oil and Gas projects

Pre-tender Document Review

Prepare conceptual designs

Information affecting design, discuss with Team Leader and follow instructions accordingly.
Prepare design delivery schedule and agree with Team Leader.

Ensures that designs are constructable, safe and economical, satisfy contract requirements, law of land, statutory provisions, if required advice modifications, additional calculations

Lesson Learned Seamless Communication, PMS, Subordinate Development Initiatives, Role Clarity, Recognition for Exceptional performance, Enhancement of Employee Motivation & Commitment, Grievance Redressal, Contribution to Learning & Development, Succession Planning

Monitoring the documentation of learning s from the project on an annual basis.

Proven expertise in the installation, commissioning, and testing of electrical and instrumentation systems.
Strong ability to manage and execute complex E&I projects with a focus on practical implementation and problem-solving.
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
Proficiency in relevant engineering software and tools.
Ability to perform under pressure and adapt to changing project requirements.

Willingness to work offshore and travel as required.
Knowledge of international standards and codes (e.g., IEC, ANSI, API) relevant to E&I execution.

Description:
Afcons Infrastructure Limited is an Indian multinational construction and engineering company based in Mumbai. The company provides infrastructure services and is involved in the construction of infrastructure projects such as viaducts, flyovers, metros, bridges, pipelines, roads, ports, barrages, oil and gas projects etc.
Roles and Responsibilities 01
Develop detailed instrumentation engineering designs, specifications, and technical drawings using INTOOLS (SPI) software.
Coordinate with Process, Electrical, and Mechanical teams to integrate instrumentation designs into overall project plans.
Lead technical reviews, including HAZOP studies, to ensure compliance with international standards (e.g., API, ANSI, ISA).
Provide expertise in control systems design, including PLC, DCS, and SCADA integration.
Specify and procure field instruments such as pressure transmitters, flow meters, temperature sensors, and control valves.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and project teams.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with regulatory requirements and company standards.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives in instrumentation design and control systems.
Key Objective of the Job Position
Provide proposal support for multiple proposals simultaneously.
Prepares and reviews engineering studies, design drawings and documents and material and equipment specifications. Resolves specialty related engineering issues by applying accepted principles, codes and standards.
Prepare check and review ILD, IO counts, P & IDs, Loops, Logical checks etc.
Involve in Pre-comm, Commissioning activities as necessary at site.
Education Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Instrumentation Engineering or related field; Master s degree preferred.
12-15 years of experience in instrumentation design within the Oil and Gas industry.
Strong knowledge of control systems (PLC, DCS, SCADA) and their application in industrial environments.
Familiarity with international standards such as API, ANSI, and ISA relevant to instrumentation and control systems.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Effective communication and collaboration skills with multidisciplinary teams.
Computer Software Proficiency
Proficiency in INTOOLS (SPI) software and AutoCAD for instrumentation design.
Work Environment
Requires the ability to travel to client, Engineering partner & Vendor Locations as well as project sites whenever required. Ability to work overtime as needed based on project.
AboutCompany:
Afcons Infrastructure Limited (Afcons) is a part of the Shapoorji Pallonji Group, which is one of Indias leading engineering and construction conglomerates. Afcons has a diverse experience of on-time execution of over 350 infrastructure projects in more than 25 countries. Afcons is ranked 10th globally in Marine and Port facilities, and 12th globally in the Bridges sector. Afcons is the only Indian company in Top 25 international contractors in both sectors.

Position Details
EY's GDS Assurance Digital teams mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our audit clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY's core Assurance practice, you'll develop a deep Audit related technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require audit departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
EY's GDS Assurance Digital team members work side-by-side with the firm's partners, clients and audit technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Assurance.
GDS Assurance Digital provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global Assurance service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking Software Engineer to join the GDS Assurance Digital practice in Bangalore, India, to work on various Microsoft technology based projects for customers across the globe.
Requirements
A Bachelor's degree (BE/BTech/MCA & MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.
Technical skills requirements
BE/BTech/MCA with a sound industry experience of 4.5 to 7 Yrs.
Strong experience in MVC, .Net Core and Entity Framework.
Strong React JS or Angular JS experience.
Solid working knowledge of relational database development: MS SQL/SQL Azure, EF 6, EF Core
Storing experience in ASP .NET, C# and or VB.NET, Windows or Web based development, Web API, Web Services, Application Blocks
Basic knowledge in Azure stack like Logic apps, Azure functions and Web Apps and deployment solutions
Unit testing: NUnit, Moq, jest
Experience using distributed version control systems: Git/SVN
Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices.
Excellent business communication
JSON and Rest API integration
Need to work as a team member to contribute in various technical streams of Microsoft Technologies.
Nice to have skill
Basic knowledge in one of the following technologies: Angular, React
Experience in Azure DevOps
Experience in Agile / Scrum methodology
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities
An ability to quickly understand complex concepts and use technology to support data modeling, analysis, visualization or process automation
Selects appropriately from applicable standards, methods, tools and applications and uses accordingly
Ability to work within a multi-disciplinary team structure, but also independently
Demonstrates analytical and systematic approach to problem solving
Communicates fluently orally and in writing and can present complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences
Able to plan, schedule and monitor work activities in order to meet time and quality targets
Able to absorb rapidly new technical information, business acumen, and apply it effectively
Ability to work in a team environment with strong customer focus, good listening, negotiation and problem-resolution skills
Additional skills requirements
The expectations are that a Senior will be able to maintain long-term client relationships and network and cultivate business development opportunities
Provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing engagement manager of engagement status, and managing staff performance.
Must have presentation skills - ability to create PowerPoint deck to communicate solution architecture to various stakeholders.
Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices
Excellent business communication, Consulting, Quality process skills
Must be a team player

Key Responsibilities
Avaloq - Monthly Goca Maintenance
Support the maintenance and updates of the Chart of Accounts of the Private Bank entities using the Avaloq Core Banking System - Swiss, Luxembourg, Guernsey, UK, Hong Kong, Singapore - by ensuring this is following the Groups FTP Chart of Account

Product Owner Administration

Customers / Stakeholders
Build strong relationships within GPB Finance teams, and IT teams

Leadership & Teamwork
Collaborative behaviours, actively share ideas / approaches with the rest of the GPB Finance teams
Utilise fully the onshore / offshore operating model

Operational Effectiveness & Control
Ensure all work is completed in accordance with appropriate Group Standard and practices
Provide assurance that any process risks identified are highlighted and managed as appropriate
Support all regulatory and compliance matters and the management of operational risk

Be able to cover a wide range of financial matters and products from accounting perspective
Partner with the Finance teams to achieve a strong and accurate maintenance of the Avaloq Chart of Account

Management of Risk
Ensure all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring
Addressing any areas of concern in conjunction with line management and/or the appropriate department

Maintains internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators
Understands, follows and demonstrates compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business in which the jobholder is involved, specifically Internal Controls and any Compliance policy including, inter alia, the Group Compliance policy

Knowledge of IFRSs and awareness of banking/finance concepts
Strong working knowledge in MS Office tools

Proven evidence of strong communication skills used to successfully lead, coordinate and conclude business discussion sessions
Ability to initiate and drive discussions with key stakeholders to effective conclusion

Good team player with proven ability of working with colleagues within & outside of own functional area/team

Proven team working and change management skills

Consistently demonstrate integrity, fairness and professional conduct

Description:
Salesforce Omnistudio Technical Lead/Architect (FSC) Manager
Key Responsibilities
Technical Design & Solutioning
Own the creation of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) covering data models, OmniStudio components, Apex architecture, integrations, security and deployment approach.
Translate functional requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce and FSC best practices.
Design the Salesforce data model, including FSC standard objects such as Person Accounts, Business Accounts, Account-Account and Account-Contact Relationships, plus custom extensions.
Make "Configuration vs. Customization" decisions. Favor declarative and OmniStudio capabilities where appropriate.
Take part in solution reviews and Design Authority forums, and contribute to architecture decisions.
Development Leadership
Lead, guide and mentor a team of Salesforce developers.
Allocate work, estimate effort, and track development progress across sprints.
Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards, design patterns, governor-limit awareness and security best practices.
Do hands-on development on complex components and act as the escalation point for technical blockers.
Define and enforce development standards, naming conventions, and reusable frameworks such as a trigger framework, error-logging framework and Integration Procedure patterns.
Delivery Ownership
Take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery: quality, timelines and scope.
Work with Project Managers on sprint planning, estimation, risk identification and mitigation.
Support SIT, UAT, performance testing, deployment and hypercare phases.
Act as the technical point of contact for client stakeholders and present designs and progress clearly.
Practice & People Development
Contribute to PwC's Salesforce practice through accelerators, reusable assets, knowledge sessions and pre-sales support such as solution estimates and RFP responses.
Coach and develop team members. Contribute to performance feedback and capability building.

Must-Have Skills
1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
Strong hands-on implementation experience with FSC (Banking, Wealth Management and/or Insurance).
Good understanding of the FSC data model, Household and Relationship management, Action Plans, Rollup-by-Lookup (RBL), Interaction Summaries and Compliant Data Sharing.
2. OmniStudio Implementation
OmniScripts: guided, multi-step user journeys with conditional logic, reusable components and custom LWC overrides.
Integration Procedures: server-side orchestration, caching, chaining, error handling and performance optimization.
Data Mappers (formerly DataRaptors): Extract, Turbo Extract, Transform and Load.
FlexCards: contextual data display and actions (highly preferred).
3. Lightning Web Components (LWC)
Build custom, reusable and performant LWCs.
Embed LWCs within OmniScripts and FlexCards.
Handle component communication, Lightning Data Service and wire adapters.
4. Business Rules Engine (BRE)
Hands-on with Decision Matrices / Lookup Tables and Expression Sets.
Implement eligibility and decisioning logic.
5. Document Generation
Experience with OmniStudio Document Generation (client-side and server-side), including template design, Data Mapper/Integration Procedure data sources, and generating PDF/DOCX outputs.
6. Salesforce Data Modelling
Design scalable data models, including object relationships, record types, and the trade-offs of master-detail vs. lookup.
7. Salesforce Design & Configuration
Strong command of declarative configuration: Flows, Validation Rules, Page Layouts, Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, Custom Metadata and Custom Settings.
Configure the security model: Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules and Field-Level Security.
Declarative Rollup summaries (DLRS)
8. Apex Development
Expert-level Apex: Triggers (framework-based), Classes, Test Classes with strong coverage and meaningful assertions, and Exception Handling.
Real-time processing: synchronous transactions and REST/SOAP callouts.
Asynchronous and batch processing: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex (including chaining), Schedulable Apex, Future Methods and Platform Events.
Strong understanding of governor limits, bulkification and performance tuning.
9. Code Quality & Reviews
Run structured code reviews.
Use static code analysis tools such as PMD, Salesforce Code Analyzer, SonarQube or Clayton.
Enforce secure coding practices: CRUD/FLS enforcement, SOQL injection prevention and with sharing usage.
10. Team Leadership & Technical Design Ownership
Proven experience leading development teams of 515 developers.
Strong track record of authoring Technical Design Documents and owning delivery outcomes.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Description:
Job Summary
WPP is seeking an Assistant Audit Manager to support our EMEA and South Asia Team team and play a key role in shaping our future. In this role, you'll leverage your audit, risk, and compliance expertise to conduct operational audits across our diverse businesses, gaining valuable exposure to various areas of WPP. This is a unique opportunity to make a real difference by identifying opportunities for improvement and driving positive change.
Were looking for candidates with a strong background in Operations, Financial, Commercial, and Compliance auditing. Youll need to be able to analyse complex business processes, identify risks (including regulatory, organisational, policy, and technological), and develop meaningful findings. Excellent communication skills and a strong commercial understanding are essential.
Location
Mumbai or Delhi
Travel
Up to 30% (availability required)
What you'll be doing
Executing internal audits for assigned cycles of the audit program by reviewing financial controls and testing compliance with established internal control policies, procedures, regulations and laws as applicable:
Compliance with policies, plans, standards, international best practices and applicable local laws and regulations that could have a significant impact on operations;
Effectiveness in the accomplishment of objectives and goals established for operations and projects;
Exercise discretion in the review of records to ensure confidentiality;
Engages in multiple assignments concurrently
Delivers projects, meeting deadlines around planning, execution and reporting
Reviews work performed by the audit team on the project to ensure that the key risks identified in the risk statement have been adequately covered;
Utilizes prior experience to identify previously captured lessons learned or best practices
Identifies and recommends opportunities for improved efficiency
Contributes to after-action reviews or post-mortem sessions to capture lessons learned
Prepares and presents reports to the Regional Head of Audit about the results of audit engagements, significant risk exposures and control issues;
Ensuring timely completion of Internal Audit work papers and audit program including documenting identified risks, issues and recommendations in the Internal Audit Software, TeamMate;
Occasional adhoc assignments including investigations
What you'll need
We want someone who can not only identify risks, but also translate those risks into business issues. You will provide consultative support to business partners to identify opportunities for control improvements. You must help prioritize findings and recommendations in tune with our corporate strategy. You should be able to facilitate multiple stakeholders to agree on appropriate solutions and verify that risks are mitigated appropriately. We value personality, insight, intellectual flexibility, teamwork and sound business judgment.
You must be an excellent writer who can succinctly communicate complicated issues in business terms. You must also be a strong project manager who can manage variable resources and conduct your own audits from beginning to end, often managing multiple projects at once.
You will be a person who anticipates problems and pro-actively seeks out solutions, whether working independently or as part of a team. You will have the ability to develop and sustain relationships with both internal and external customers, have a hands on attitude to work; and the flexibility to work as hard as the job demands.
Professional skills
Strong risk management experience, including; performing risk assessments and audits, designing controls, and prioritizing risk.
Strong analytical skills. Proven history of analyzing data, having attention to detail, and assessing situations to identify meaningful observations.
Personal skills
Self-starter, possess flexibility to work in a fast-changing environment and ambiguous situations and get things done
Proven history of having built relationships and worked effectively across cross-functional teams and business functions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You will prepare reports and make presentations to senior level management. You will interact with various levels of employees to collect and communicate information.
Ability to work independently, but also be a team player and critical thinker.
Ability to manage multiple projects
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
A naturally inquisitive, assertive (not aggressive) and tenacious character.
Thorough and precise.

Strategic & Financial Leadership

Business Development & Key Accounts

Commodity Market Analysis

B2B Brand Management

Commercial Strategy & Trading

Team Management

Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
