Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Advising on IT integration, separation, and carve-out strategies across various IT domains.
Mentoring and coaching senior associates and associates to consistently deliver impactful work.
Contributing to business development initiatives by identifying and researching opportunities with new and existing clients.

Proven experience in IT M&A including IT due diligence, integration, separation planning, and execution.

Description:
As a GenAI Full Stack Senior Associate you will support the design and development of full stack GenAI solutions, turning business needs into practical data and technology deliverables within our Data & Analytics Engineering practice. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build client relationships, and guide junior team members while navigating changing priorities and using critical thinking to shape solution delivery. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will apply data science methods, use modern development tools and techniques, interpret data for insights, and contribute to AI-driven automation and cognitive solutions that support client needs.
Responsibilities
- Design and develop responsive, performant user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js), implementing reusable component libraries and ensuring design consistency.
- Optimize frontend performance through techniques like lazy loading, code splitting, caching, and efficient rendering strategies for scalable web applications.
- Build, secure, and maintain scalable REST and GraphQL APIs and backend services using Node.js, Java Spring Boot, or Python, handling business logic, data validation, and error handling.
- Develop and manage microservices architectures and design relational and NoSQL database schemas with optimized queries and migrations for production environments.
- Deploy applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) leveraging Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) for continuous integration and delivery.
- Collaborate closely with product managers to translate UX designs and user stories into pixel-perfect, accessible, and consistent user interfaces across devices and browsers.
What You Must Have
- Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Experience working with AI or Generative AI tools-based applications.
- Strong backend development skills using Node.js, Nest.js, Java Spring Boot, or Python frameworks, with solid understanding of RESTful APIs and GraphQL.
- Proficient in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks like React, Vue.js, or Next.js.
- Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB, along with authentication and authorization mechanisms.
- Knowledgeable in version control systems, preferably Git, to manage code and collaborate effectively.
CompanyAddress: 4th Floor, Bagmane Tech Park, Byrasandra Village, KR Puram Hobli, CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, KA, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).

Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

About The Role

Good to have skills:R, Spark, data bricks, Ability to leverage design thinking, business process optimization, and stakeholder management skills.





Job

Summary:

This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.





Roles & Responsibilities:
Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes.
Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates.
Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector.
Demonstrate knowledge of life sciences datasets and maintain strong domain expertise to drive the development of robust analytics solutions.
Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions.
Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities.





WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
An opportunity to work on high-visibility projects with top Pharma clients around the globe.
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities.
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.





What you would do in this role
Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients.
Responsibilities may include strategy, implementation, process design, and change management for specific modules.
Work with the team or as an Individual contributor on the project assigned which includes a variety of skills to be utilized from Data Engineering to Data Science
Provide Subject matter expertise in various sub-segments of the LS industry.
Develop assets and methodologies, point-of-view, research, or white papers for use by the team and the larger community.
Acquire new skills that have utility across industry groups.
Support strategies and operating models focused on some business units and assess likely competitive responses. Also, assess implementation readiness and points of greatest impact.
Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables.
Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the client’s business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change.
Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain.



Who are we looking for?
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.
Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on Life Sciences/Pharma/Healthcare projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Excellent understanding of Pharma data sets – commercial, clinical, RWE (Real World Evidence) & EMR (Electronic medical records)
Leverage one’s hands on experience of working across one or more of these areas such as real-world evidence data, R&D clinical data, digital marketing data.
Hands-on experience with handling Datasets like Komodo, RAVE, IQVIA, Truven, Optum etc.
Hands-on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Proficiency in Programming languages such as Python, SQL, Spark, etc.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings/insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL.
Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Experience with any of the Data Visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview, Spotfire is good to have.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc.
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills



Professional & Technical


Skills:


- Relevant experience in the required domain.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.






Additional Information:

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects.

- Career growth and leadership exposure.

About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design Specialist

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:9- Specialist

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 6-8 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Consultant in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Collaborate with the client team to understand the business problem, identify the solution approach and work through the design, development, and delivery phases.
Conduct Training Needs Analysis to develop the training curriculum.
Develop high-quality and detailed content outlines as per the curriculum.
Design standards, guidelines, templates, and checklists for the proposed learning solution.
Collaborate with internal and client stakeholders to design and develop relevant and effective training deliverables.
Review training deliverables to ensure that the deliverable quality is as per the project quality parameters and industry standards.
Identify and share the risks with the Project Leads/Functional Manager to discuss possible solutions/mitigations/alternatives.
Coach instructional designers and content developers to prepare materials for instructor development workshops.
Provide clear and effective feedback to team with the intent to develop their instructional design skills.
Identify opportunities to implement new and innovative learning strategies into the solution.
Leverage proficiency in instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, content design, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Apply your strong knowledge in industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:6+years of proven experience in content development and instructional designing
Extensive experience in developing, reviewing and delivering different training modalities like Instructor-Led Trainings, Web-Based Trainings, application simulations, job aids, and quick reference guides
Experience in leading and coaching small teams independently



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.

Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in shifts as required.
Specific Qualifications:
Graduation in any discipline
DELF B1 and above certification in French language
Location: Mumbai/ Chennai/ Bangalore
About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
About BNP Paribas India Solutions:
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

Prior experience specifically supporting Japanese automotive clients (e.g. DENSO, Toyota Group, Honda, Nissan, Suzuki, or their Tier-1 supplier ecosystem).
Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules from prior implementation, support, or super-user experience.
JETRO or other formal bilingual business-communication certification.
Prior experience as a bridge engineer, IT coordinator, or business analyst in a Japanese-client environment — candidates strong on language and automotive-industry fit will be considered even without direct Oracle exposure, with structured platform training provided on the job.

Description:
VP Project Management / Delivery


About the Role:
We are looking for a seasoned delivery leader to head large-scale content and learning solution projects across global EdTech clients. The AVP will own end-to-end program delivery, drive operational excellence, ensure client success, and scale delivery teams for high-quality, on-time, and profitable execution. This role requires a strong blend of strategic leadership, client management, and delivery governance in a fast-paced, multi-project environment.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Delivery Leadership
Own end-to-end delivery of digital learning, curriculum, and content development programs
Manage multiple large and mid-sized projects across enterprise and university clients
Ensure delivery within scope, schedule, cost, and quality benchmarks
Establish scalable delivery frameworks, SOPs, and governance models
2. Program & Portfolio Management
Oversee a portfolio of projects with cross-functional teams (IDs, SMEs, media, tech, QA)
Drive effective resource planning, utilization, and capacity forecasting
Monitor risks, dependencies, and escalations; implement mitigation strategies
Track delivery KPIs, SLAs, and financial performance (margin, cost, productivity)
3. Client & Stakeholder Management
Act as executive delivery SPOC for key enterprise and EdTech accounts
Lead client reviews, QBRs, and governance calls
Manage expectations, change requests, and long-term engagement growth
Partner with Sales/Presales for solutioning and transition of new projects
4. Team Leadership & Capability Building
Lead and mentor Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and cross-functional leads
Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability and outcomes
Drive capability development in instructional design, digital content, and learning technologies
Set performance goals and career paths for delivery teams
5. Process Excellence & Quality
Define and enforce delivery standards, quality frameworks, and review mechanisms
Drive continuous improvement using metrics, retrospectives, and automation
Implement tools and best practices in project tracking, collaboration, and reporting
Ensure compliance with client, data security, and process standards

6. Financial & Operational Ownership
Own delivery P&L levers: effort estimation, cost control, margin optimization
Improve productivity through process optimization and AI-enabled workflows where applicable
Support budgeting, forecasting, and revenue realization
Qualifications & Experience:
Bachelors degree
15–20 years of experience in Project / Program / Delivery Management
Digital learning / eLearning development
Curriculum and content production workflows
Proven experience managing large teams (30–100+) and multi-million-dollar portfolios
Experience working with global clients
Strong understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models
Key Competencies
Strategic delivery leadership
Executive stakeholder management
Program & portfolio governance
Risk & escalation management
People, leadership, and talent development
Data-driven decision making
Operational excellence mindset

Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.

- Creating technical specification documents for data services jobs based on migration experience and programming knowledge
- Supporting data cleansing and validation activities using tools like Information Steward, Excel, and SQL

- Utilizing Snaplogic for data migration from source systems to S/4 HANA
- Building and maintaining client relationships to understand and address their data management needs

Description:
JOB OVERVIEW


We are seeking an experienced Billing Platform Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the entire Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in both Billing and Revenue capabilities, with extensive experience in subscription billing, usage-based billing, pricing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will drive business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, engage with executive stakeholders, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs.
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, architecture, business process design, functional and technical design, application configuration, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts, testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, and stakeholder communication while driving successful project milestones.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a key role in practice development by contributing to solution accelerators, AI-enabled delivery, capability building, pre-sales, client workshops, and thought leadership initiatives. The individual will work closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, improve business outcomes, and support enterprise growth.


Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the solution architecture and design for enterprise Quote-to-Cash transformations across Billing and Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations. Lead end-to-end Billing Platform solution architecture for large-scale implementation programs.
Manage end-to-end implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution design, configuration, development, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, and hypercare while leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmap.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate workshops, perform fit-gap analysis, develop scalable solution designs, and provide strategic recommendations aligned with industry best practices. Excellent client-facing skills and communication (written/verbal) skills
Establish delivery governance, manage project risks and dependencies, review solution quality, ensure compliance with architectural standards, and drive successful milestone execution through proactive stakeholder communication and issue resolution.
Contribute to practice development through pre-sales, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, capability building, mentoring, solution assets, thought leadership, and the development of reusable frameworks that enhance delivery efficiency and support business growth.
Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes.
Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses
Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation.
Understand customer business processes/functional specifications and independently drive technical solutioning to delivery
Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution
Must ensure teams follow the correct procedures, best practices and documentation requirements across project phases
Drive solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Technical Skills:
API, SQL, CSS, HTML, Java Script, JSON and XML
Certifications:
BillingPlatform Partner Essential Certification (L1)
BillingPlatform Partner Pro Certification (L2)
BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)
Additional Job DescriptionAdditional Job DescriptionThe Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Senior Manager - Billing Platform - Finance Solutions, you will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to drive business transformation initiatives, translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. You will engage with executive stakeholders, delivering large-scale digital transformation programs that optimize revenue operations and support enterprise growth.

As a Senior Manager, you will guide cross-functional teams, applying sound judgment and strategic advising to solve complex problems. You will motivate and coach teams, fostering a diverse and inclusive environment that contributes to the firm's success. Your role involves crafting impactful messages, validating outcomes with clients, and navigating challenging situations with composure. You will also contribute to practice development through thought leadership initiatives and capability building.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on implementing Oracle lead management and customer experience solutions, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Your leadership in project management, delivery governance, and stakeholder communication will drive successful project milestones and enhance delivery efficiency.

Responsibilities

- Leading the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle
- Translating complex business requirements into scalable and secure Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry practices
- Managing end-to-end implementation programs, including project planning, solution design, configuration, development, and deployment
- Engaging with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and provide strategic recommendations
- Overseeing the development of integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle ERP
- Driving business transformation initiatives by leveraging functional, technical, and consulting skills
- Facilitating workshops and performing fit-gap analysis to develop scalable solution designs
- Contributing to practice development through pre-sales, capability building, and thought leadership initiatives
- Building and maintaining billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, and revenue-related processes
- Validating solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle and managing project risks and dependencies
- Leading business discussions with customers to discover requirements and deliver technical solutions
- Confirming compliance with architectural standards and driving successful milestone execution through proactive communication

What You Must Have

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 12 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Marketing, Commerce, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Lead-to-Revenue or related Oracle Customer Experience (CX) Revenue Cloud applications
- Possessing BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)
- Demonstrating proficiency in API, SQL, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, JSON, and XML
- Leading large-scale digital transformation programs in finance operations
- Excelling in client-facing communication and stakeholder engagement
- Developing scalable solution designs aligned with industry best practices

Being sensible and reflective

Roles & ResponsibilitiesA day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment

You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs

You will create requirement specifications from the business needs, define the to-be-processes and detailed functional designs based on requirements.

You will support configuring solution requirements on the products; understand if any issues, diagnose the root-cause of such issues, seek clarifications, and then identify and shortlist solution alternatives

You will also contribute to unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers.

If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
Technical Requirement
2 + years of work experience (certification is preference) in Callidus Cloud (SAP) Commissions.
Experience in Callidus Cloud Advanced Workflows is added advantage. Knowledge of Crystal reports is also a plus.
Should have experience of working in at least 1 end to end implementations in Callidus Cloud Commissions.
Additional Responsibility
Ability to develop value-creating strategies and models that enable clients to innovate, drive growth and increase their business profitability
Good knowledge on software configuration management systems
Awareness of latest technologies and Industry trends
Logical thinking and problem-solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
Understanding of the financial processes for various types of projects and the various pricing models available
Ability to assess the current processes, identify improvement areas and suggest the technology solutions
One or two industry domain knowledge
Client Interfacing skills
Project and Team management

Location of posting - Infosys Ltd. is committed to ensuring you have the best experience throughout your journey with us. We currently have open positions in a number of locations across India - Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Indore, Nagpur, Mangalore, Noida, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Coimbatore, Mumbai, Jaipur, Mysore and Hubli. While we work in accordance with business requirements, we shall strive to offer you the location of your choice, where possible.

Position: Full Stack Engineer
Experience: 6+ Years
Job Locations: Pune, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners to 60 Days
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in both front-end and back-end technologies, along with experience in cloud platforms, API development, and modern software development practices.

Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality web applications.
Build scalable and responsive front-end applications using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Develop robust back-end services using Java, Node.js, or Python.
Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, and cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
Create and consume RESTful APIs and microservices.
Work with relational and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Ensure application performance, security, scalability, and reliability.
Participate in code reviews and follow best coding practices.
Implement automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends.

Required Skills:
6+ years of experience in Full Stack Development.
Strong proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript.
Hands-on experience with React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Strong experience in server-side development using Java, Node.js, or Python.
Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
Good knowledge of database technologies including MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Experience with Git and version control systems.
Knowledge of CI/CD tools and automated testing frameworks.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Skills:
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments.
Exposure to DevOps practices and monitoring tools.
Understanding of security best practices and performance optimization.

Job Description: AEO / SEO / GEO Specialist, Trivitron Digital.ai

Location: Chennai / Mumbai / Bangalore (Onsite only)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 4-8 years

Reports to: Head of Growth / Digital Transformation

About Trivitron Digital.ai (TDAI):
Trivitron Digital.ai is an AI-powered health technology platform. It is a joint venture between Trivitron Healthcare and
ResoHealth. Our products include LIS, RIS, HIS, CRM, LIMS, Claims IQ, peri-operative AI and an AI Health Companion.
Hospitals, diagnostic labs and wellness providers across India, the GCC and emerging markets use them.

The Role:
People now look for information in two places: traditional search engines and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini,
Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. We want TDAI and our customers to be the trusted answer in both. In this role youll
own organic visibility for TDAIs brand and products. Youll also help our hospital, diagnostics and wellness customers grow
their own search and AI visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

1. SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Own technical, on-page and off-page SEO for TDAI’s websites and product pages
Do keyword research for B2B healthtech terms (e.g., “LIS software India”, “hospital management system UAE”)
and for patient-facing searches made to our customers
Build high-quality backlinks from healthcare, health IT and industry publications in India and the GCC
Run local SEO (Google Business Profile, directories, citations) for multi-location hospital and diagnostic chains
2. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Structure content so it gets picked up for featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search and AI Overviews
Implement schema markup (MedicalOrganization, Hospital, MedicalTest, FAQ, Product, Organization)
Build FAQ and Q&A content hubs that answer real buyer and patient questions
3. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Track and improve how TDAI and our customers are cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Claude
Build entity authority through Wikipedia/Wikidata, knowledge panels, authoritative mentions, PR and citationworthy
content (research, benchmarks, reports)
Set up prompt-level tracking for brand share-of-voice in AI answers and report on it
4. Customer Growth Services
Audit and improve search and AI visibility for hospital, diagnostics and wellness clients
Create playbooks for doctor profiles, test/package pages, location pages and review management
Connect visibility to business outcomes: appointments, test bookings, leads and footfall
5. Content, Compliance and Collaboration
Work with content, product, clinical and sales teams on content that is accurate and meets E-E-A-T standards
Follow healthcare content norms: medical review, no misleading claims, and data privacy (DPDP Act, UAE regulations)
Track and report on rankings, organic traffic, AI citations, DA/DR, leads and conversions

What You Bring:
4–8 years in SEO, with hands-on exposure to AEO/GEO or AI search visibility
Experience in healthcare, healthtech, diagnostics, hospitals or B2B SaaS (strongly preferred)
Strong command of Ahrefs/SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and schema tools
Familiarity with AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, Otterly, Peec AI, or your own tracking methods)
Working knowledge of HTML, structured data, site architecture and CMS platforms (WordPress, headless CMS)
Excellent written English; regional languages or Arabic are a plus
A proven track record of moving rankings, traffic and leads, with case studies to show

KPIs:
Organic traffic and qualified leads from search
Rankings for priority keywords (India and GCC)
Brand mentions and citations in AI answer engines
Featured snippets and AI Overview inclusions
DA/DR and growth in high-quality backlinks
Measurable visibility gains for customer accounts

CMS Info Systems is looking for high-performing Hunter Sales Professionals with proven experience in B2B Solution Sales, Service Sales, Enterprise Sales, Technology Sales, or Corporate Sales.

Drive new business acquisition and enterprise account penetration.
Sell CMS solutions including Retail Cash Management, AIoT/VSaaS Remote Monitoring, CDM, Banking Automation, and Managed Services.
Engage with Large Enterprises, NBFCs, MFIs, E-commerce, Logistics, Retail, and Government clients.

Cash Management Services: ATM cash replenishment, cash-in-transit, retail cash logistics, and vault solutions.
Managed Services: ATM manufacturing & maintenance, banking automation, and AIoT-based remote monitoring.
Card Solutions: Card personalization, issuance, and related managed services for banks.

Manages 72,000+ ATMs
Supports 12,000+ bank branches

Description:
Dear Candidate,


This is with reference for AWS Data Engineer Professionals

PFB the Job Description

Key responsibilities
Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
Design and build Gluebased ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
Build automated dataquality gates, reconciliation checks, and sourcetoreport lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of businesscritical reports
Implement IAM, AWSnative encryption, Secrets Manager and Goldlayer RBAC/leastprivilege access.
Establish Dev/Test environments, Gitbased CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

Mandatory skills
10+ years in data engineering with 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
Amazon Redshift (deep): data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and handson medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
Python (primary) PySpark for Glue jobs.
MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
dbt must be able to read, reverseengineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
Dataquality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
Git,CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

Nice to have
Dagster orchestration for ASIS discovery and migration.
Kafka / eventdriven streaming ingestion.
Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
Tableau, Metabase servinglayer knowledge.
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
Datagovernance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).

Total Overall Experience-10-15years

- Utilizing analytical thinking for business process improvement

Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.

Job Description
Job Description
This role requires > 8 years of experience working in the areas of pesticide/agrochemical formulation development and able to work in the formulation lab.
Lead the development of Crop Protection formulations
To formulate, generate scientific / technical data using established systems, procedures, and protocols in an area of work delegated by the manager.
Define the experimental programme that include the development of new pesticide formulations, procedures/standards.
To interpret data in order to make contributions to decisions in the work programme content, procedures, or problem solution.
Engages directly with other functions to co-ordinate delivery of project outputs (e. g. product biology, regulatory, procurement team, engineering team, packaging etc) with the support of a leader.
Report on work, including recommendations to project team or sub-project team leader.
Participate in regional and global technical / project teams
Will represent the formulation development work/status at every developmental stage to global peer review team and adhere to project timelines.
ACCOUNTABILITIES
To plan, organise and carry out the work programmes at the laboratory, semi-technical, pilot plant or manufacturing scale to design novel pesticide formulation options in order to:
Prove the suitability for progression through Stage C and D Evaluation and Development
Provide Product Chemistry type and or supporting data, and
Provide the formulation design input required to define the process equipment and quality assurance requirements to timescales and specifications agreed with the team or group leader.
Ensure the quality of Evaluation and Development formulations by arranging for biological efficacy, toxicology, and hazard assessment studies to be carried out in other Functions.
Provide advice and recommendations to allow appropriate selection of formulation manufacturing sites for individual products, together with the product design inputs required to define the process equipment and quality assurance requirements.
To interpret and represent to project members external to the function, experimental data and report results and conclusions obtained both orally and in written form to allow cogent and timely Stage C and D project decisions, Regulatory submissions and accurate information archiving and transfer for future commercial manufacturing activities.
To ensure that work by the job holder and subordinate staff comply with Syngenta standard operating procedures and statutory regulations (e. g. GLP or similar).
To ensure that the jobholder and subordinate staff work safely and healthy with due care for others, so that compliance with Syngenta s HSE Policy is achieved.
To invest in personal and professional development and growth, undertaking, where appropriate, training and development activities and ensuring familiarity with new research and literature.
Ensure maintaining complete confidentiality of all Syngenta intellectual property.
Interact with the global formulation community in order to better solve common problems and to define improved processes Qualifications
Qualifications
KNOWLEDGE EXPERIENCE and CAPABILITIES:
Critical knowledge and experience
Master s degree in Pesticide/Agrochemical chemistry must/preferable from reputed universities with strong academic records and good communication skills with > 8 years of industrial experience in field of pesticide formulation development as a formulation development chemist preferred.
Thorough knowledge of pesticides, pesticide formulation types and techniques required in formulation development.
Sound understanding of agrochemical formulations / Coformulations / Fillers is a must
Critical technical, professional, and personal capabilities
Ability to efficiently build up laboratory works and experiments
Ability to effectively participation in- and contribute to regional / global multi-functional teams
Ability to deliver to agreed timelines
Excellent operational, organisational, interpersonal and computer skills
Sensitive to different cultural environments
Self-motivating
Critical leadership capabilities
Communicative

We are keen to listen and learn
Team Oriented
We model commitment

We collaborate effectively across organisational and functional boundaries
Results Oriented

Critical success factors and key challenges
This role will involve taking a lead role in the development of new formulations by generating potential formulation options through the design of appropriate experimental work programs to thoroughly optimise and test these according to the formulation development process.
This will include the analysis of experimental data in order to make inputs to the decisions on the direction of the work programmes within the project.
The job holder will need to have experience of different formulation types as well as a full range of broader requirements in formulation development such as product application, manufacturing processes, etc.
To deliver highest quality results in optimal time and maintain highest standards of HSE

Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship

80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales Qualifications
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)

Description:
The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers.
Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel.
This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness.
This role focuses on showcasing Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons.
As part of the Marketing and Communication team, this role is fully connected into resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization.
This role also gets to do a little bit of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel.
Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and communications campaigns.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
Required:
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Hotel Marketing and Advertising
- Executes annual marketing plan to budget, in consultation with the GM, Food and Beverage leader, Operations leaders, Director of Marketing Communications, and cluster marketing and ecommerce teams.
- Partners with Operations, Food & Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.
- Acts as the liaison between the marketing department and advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions.
- Manages F&B media schedules and verifies prompt settlement of accounts.
- Partners with property Revenue Management to verify correct offer loading, verifying advertisement targeting is correctly directed at relevant consumer groups
- Executes email marketing, and display advertising.
- Maintains frequent, active engagement with Cluster eCommerce manager to verify alignment, pull-through, and 2-way communication about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.
- Verifies all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice.
Social Media Content Management
- Facilitates social media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (eg, hotel website, travel sites).
- Develops and executes promotions campaign in F&B, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels.
- Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly.
Public Relations and Visual Asset Management
- Develops a comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency and and executes post sign-off from GM.
- Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers.
- Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system.
- Writes and distributes all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets.
- Manages the execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities.
- Supports pull through of impactful PR strategy & activities to drive quality press coverage through media engagement, in alignment with communications objectives.
- Verifies the news clippings and other online, print, and social media mention report is completed on a monthly basis for property distribution.
- Manages external vendors and media agencies; works with agency partners and continent PR leader to identify strategic media buys for their hotel(s).
- Surfaces and vets PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel.
- Supports the co-ordination of photography for F&B advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams.
- Manages photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team.
- Acts as central point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery; coordinates with area or cluster marketing to verify all photography adheres to brand voice.
Direct Marketing and Collateral Development
- Coordinates and executes Hotel and F&B printed materials.
- Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.
- Assists in the production of all property, F&B display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.
- Promotes collection of competitors collateral and publicity on a monthly basis.
- Manages the execution of F&B direct marketing activities.
- Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA).
General
- Assists and manages the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities with a strong emphasis on property F&B promotions and campaigns.
- Helps with the publication of hotel s newsletter(s).
- Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary.
- Assists in the liaison and execution of joint F&B promotions.
- Works with eCommerce to verify the Hotel s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis.
- Partners with Director of Marketing to create marketing plan aligned to hotel sales and revenue strategy.
- Provides training and marketing leadership and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders.
- Coordinates with property and above property eCommerce and Revenue Management teams to report success of property marketing and eCommerce performance.
- Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Title : Pharmacist
Department : Pharmacy & Stores
Reporting To : Zonal Head
Job Summary
The Pharmacist at V Care is responsible for safe dispensing and sale of medicines, effective inventory management, statutory compliance related to pharmacy licences and records, and supporting sales of approved FMCG and clinic-owned wellness products, while ensuring adherence to applicable drug laws and clinical protocols.
Key Responsibilities
1. Pharmacy Operations & Medicine Sales
Dispense prescription and non-prescription medicines as per valid prescriptions and clinic protocols
Ensure correct dosage, labeling, and patient counseling where required
Monitor storage conditions for medicines including temperature-sensitive products
Prevent sale of expired, damaged, or unapproved medicines
2. Inventory & Store Management
Maintain accurate stock records for medicines, consumables, surgical items, and FMCG products
Monitor minimum and maximum stock levels and raise purchase indents on time
Perform regular stock verification, reconciliation, and expiry checks
Ensure proper segregation of Schedule H / H1 / other regulated drugs as applicable
3. Licensing & Documentation Compliance
Assist in maintenance and renewal of pharmacy licences and related statutory approvals
Maintain mandatory registers, invoices, purchase bills, and sale records
Support compliance during inspections by Drug Inspector / Clinical Establishment authorities
Ensure SOPs are followed for storage, dispensing, and documentation
4. FMCG & Clinic Product Sales
Handle billing and sale of approved FMCG, cosmetic, dermatology, and hair-care products
Educate patients on proper usage of clinic-recommended products
Support promotional activities and cross-selling of clinic wellness products ethically
Maintain separate stock and sales records for FMCG and non-drug items
5. Coordination & Support
Coordinate with doctors, nurses, therapists, and procurement teams
Assist in indenting and receiving stocks from approved vendors
Support smooth functioning of day-care procedures with timely availability of medicines and consumables
6. Quality, Safety & Ethics
Follow ethical pharmacy practices and confidentiality norms
Ensure adherence to Drug & Cosmetics Act and clinic policies
Report discrepancies, near misses, or compliance issues promptly
Qualifications & Skills
D.Pharm / B.Pharm (mandatory)
Valid State Pharmacy Council Registration
Knowledge of drug laws, pharmacy documentation, and inventory systems
Basic computer skills (billing software, stock registers, MS Excel)
Good communication and customer-handling skills
Preferred Experience
Experience in clinic / hospital / specialty centre pharmacy preferred
Exposure to dermatology, cosmetic, or surgical clinic setup is an added advantage

Work location: Kazhakootam, Kottayam, Ambattur, Coimbatore, Bangalore - Sadashivanagar, Goa - Margoa.

Description:
Functions as the strategic business leader of property operations and acts as General Manager in his/her absence.
Areas of responsibility include Front Office, , Retail/Gift Shops, Recreation/Fitness Center, Housekeeping, Security/Loss Prevention, Engineering/Maintece, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Event Management, where applicable.
Position works with direct reports (Executive Committee members and department heads) to develop and implement the operations strategy and ensuring implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
The position ensuring operations meet the brand s target customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes ficial performance.
As a member of the Executive Committee, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Profitability and Departmental Budgets
- Keeps operations team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired ficial results.
- Ensures that all operational areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.
- Reviews ficial reports and statements to determine how Operations is performing against budget.
- Ensures capital expenditure funds are being used to address the priorities outlined in the service strategy.
- Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establishing ways to improve the departments ficial performance.
- Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.
- Identifies and analyzes operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
- Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy rate, wages and controllable expenses.
- Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holds team accountable for results.
- Develops an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand s business strategy and leads its execution.
- Makes and executes key decisions to keep property moving forward towards achievement of goals.
Managing Property Operations
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding operational goals to produce desired results on a continuous basis.
- Ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
- Ensures core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.
- Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
Leading Property Operations Teams
- Establishes a vision for product and service delivery on property.
- Champions the brand s service vision for product and service delivery and ensuring alignment amongst the property leadership team.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Hires operations management team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
- Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
- Utilizes an open door policy and reviewing employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Stays knowledgeable of leadership talent in the property.
- Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.

Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.

Ensure the achievement of department objectives and monitor product cost, quality, and timeliness as per production / delivery plan.
Ensure all production / filling-packing lines have high operational performance and process capability to deliver products as per established standards.
Plan and coordinate all maintenance activities viz. routine, periodic maintenance and CIP / shutdown activities.
Establish and implement a maintenance strategy and schedule supported by all functions thereby ensuring availability of lines / plant (production and infrastructure) to ensure optimum utilisation of assets and resources.

2. Compliance
Ensure product and process compliance in line with Nestl policies, standards and legal requirements.
Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.
Conduct inspection / audits and investigate incidents to close gaps.
Ensure good and hygienic engineering practices are applied at all times.
