Description:
Assists with identifying and addressing employee and organizational development needs.
The position is assist in ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results.
Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills.
Assists in conducting needs assessments, designing and developing training programs and facilitating the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs.
Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting with Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Assisting with Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Assisting with Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Assists with making any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Assists with establishing guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Assisting with Managing Training Budgets
- Assists with the development of the Training budget as required.
- Assists with managing budget in alignment with Human Resources and property ficial goals.
- Assists with managing department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Strong local market knowledge.

Candidates with experience in channel sales, distributor management or partner-led business models.
Self-driven individuals with strong networking and relationship-building skills.
Ability to work independently and achieve business targets.

*What is this role about?*
This role is about **expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets*
You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.
This is a *field-based role* and requires regular travel.
*What will you do in this role?*
• Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
• Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
• Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
• Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
• Negotiate commercials and close property signings
• Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
• Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
• Review agreements and service levels with property owners
• Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams
*How is your performance measured?*
• Number of sellable rooms signed every month
• Number of rooms made live and available for booking
• Gross margin generated from signed properties
*Education:*
• Graduation mandatory
• MBA preferred
**Experience & Skills:**
• 1–5 years of relevant experience
• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
• Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
• Analytical and data-driven mindset
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
• Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
• Good Excel skills and professional email writing
*Stakeholders you will work with:*
*Internal:*
• Business Development Head
• Hub Head
• Central Team
• Operations Team
• Transformation Team
• Legal Team
*External:*
• Property Owners
• Real Estate Brokers
*In simple words:*
Your role is to *find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable*.

Position Overview
The Government of Jharkhand, in partnership with Room to Read and Jharkhand Education Project Council (JEPC), is establishing a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) to enhance the quality of education in the state, with a specific focus on Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN). As part of this initiative, Balvatika will focus on early childhood learning interventions for children in the 3-6 age group. The Associate will report directly to Officer, Literacy at State and will support the planning, implementation, and monitoring of Balvatika-related interventions across the state.
Responsibilities
Support the design and rollout of Balvatika interventions aligned with NCERT guidelines and NIPUN Bharat mission.
Contribute to creating developmentally appropriate, contextualized curriculum and other instructional material with the adaptation of the National Early Childhood Education Curriculum, Adhaarshila , to the Jharkhand context.
Coordinate with JEPC, SCERT, and DIETs to align early learning goals with the state s academic calendar and training plans.
Assist in developing the Training content, including framework, training modules.
Organize and support training programs for teachers, Anganwadi workers, and master trainers at state, district, and block levels.
Participate in classroom observations and learning assessments at selected sites.
Provide feedback to improve ECE delivery and the learning environment based on the observation findings.
Monitor implementation progress of Balvatika components in identified schools and Anganwadi-linked Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE) centers.
Conduct field visits and collect qualitative and quantitative data on early learning indicators.
Prepare documentation, progress reports, and case studies highlighting best practices and challenges.
Provide administrative and technical support to the SPMU team related to early childhood education.
Liaise with stakeholders including government bodies, partners, and academic institutions.
Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Education, Child Development, Social Work, or relevant field. Master s degree preferred.
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in early childhood education, FLN projects, or related development sector roles.
Strong understanding of pedagogy in Early childhood years. Effective learning ways for children, the role of the classroom environment in learning.
Understanding of ECCE curriculum and NIPUN Bharat guidelines.
Proficient in data collection, analysis, and report writing.
Experience working with government systems, particularly in Jharkhand or similar contexts.
Strong communication skills in Hindi and English.
Willingness to travel extensively within the state.

Position: Technical Retail Associate (TRA)
POC: Anubhavi Singh
Contact no: 8448285788
Location: Ranchi
Salary Budget: Up to 4 LPA
Work Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Retail Associate (TRA) who will be responsible for handling walk-in customers at the Cars24 yard, understanding their requirements, conducting basic vehicle inspections, and assisting customers in selling their cars through Cars24.

The ideal candidate should have good technical knowledge of cars, strong customer-handling and negotiation skills, and a valid driving license.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle and assist walk-in customers at the Cars24 yard.
* Conduct basic inspection and evaluation of customer vehicles.
* Explain the vehicle inspection process and provide relevant information to customers.
* Pitch and convince customers to sell their cars through Cars24.
* Explain and sell the Car Health Report to customers.
* Build strong relationships with customers and ensure a smooth customer experience.
* Handle customer queries, objections, and concerns professionally.
* Negotiate with customers and work towards successful deal closure.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth processing of vehicle sales.
* Maintain accurate customer and vehicle-related information in the system.
* Achieve assigned sales, conversion, and business targets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Good technical knowledge of cars and basic automobile understanding.
* Strong communication and customer-handling skills.
* Good negotiation and convincing skills.
* Ability to pitch products/services and convert leads into successful transactions.
* Valid Driving License is mandatory.
* Comfortable working in a yard-based and customer-facing environment.
* Willingness to handle calling and follow-ups with customers.
* Prior experience in automobile sales, car inspection, vehicle evaluation, retail sales, or customer-facing roles will be preferred.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* Customer-focused and confident.
* Good at communication and negotiation.
* Comfortable with calling and face-to-face customer interaction.
* Passionate about automobiles and knowledgeable about cars.
* Target-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Note: Saturday and Sunday will be working days. Your weekly off will be provided on any one day between Monday and Friday, based on the business requirements and roster.Role & responsibilities

Title: Business Development Executive \ Field sales apprentice role
Location: Ranchi (Retail Store Based)
Job Type: Full\-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics \/ Retail \/ FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store\-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast\-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
\- Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
\- Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
\- Conduct in\-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
\- Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
\- Support retail partners with business development strategies and on\-ground execution
\- Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
\- Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass\-out)
\- Freshers are encouraged to apply
\- Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
\- Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
\- Personal two\-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
\- Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty\/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
\- Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
\- Work Schedule: 6 days a week
\- Weekly Off: Sunday
\- Work Type: Retail store\-based with regular local market visits

Apply Now

What will you drive?
As a Retail Associate, your primary responsibility will be to build strong relationships with New Car Dealerships (NCDs)and generate high-quality leads for customers looking to sell or exchange their cars.
Your day will revolve around visiting 3-5 NCD outlets daily, engaging with dealer partners, and identifying customers interested in selling their old vehicles or opting for exchange deals. You will act as the face of CARS24 on the ground ensuring that every potential lead is captured, nurtured, and converted through our platform.
This role is not just about visits its about consistent follow-ups, relationship management, and closing deals. Strong coordination with dealers and timely follow-ups on leads will be critical to your success.
You will work towards monthly targets, where your performance will be measured based on lead generation, conversions, and dealer engagement quality. Your persuasion and negotiation skills will play a key role in turning opportunities into successful transactions.
To set you up for success, you will go through 715 days of structured training(classroom + on-field), equipping you with the right product knowledge, sales techniques, and tools.
Expect a high-performance environment with attractive incentives tied to your achievements because at CARS24, we celebrate results and reward top performers.

Visit4-6 Dealerships daily to generate leads
Identify customers interested in selling or exchanging their cars
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealer partners
Ensure consistent follow-ups with NCDs for lead flow
Convert leads into successful transactions via CARS24
Maintain accurate records of visits, leads, and conversions
Achieve monthly sales and conversion targets

Working Days
6 days a week
Week off during weekdays

Who are we looking for?
Strong field sales mindset with willingness to travel daily
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Ability to follow up persistently and close deals
Self-driven, target-oriented, and highly energetic
Prior experience in automobile, dealership, or field sales is a plus

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Account Partner Relationship Management

Department: Sales & Business Development
Industry: Health Insurance / Insurance Distribution

1. About the Role
Smart IT Services Pvt. Ltd. is looking for energetic, customer-focused, and target-oriented candidates for the position of Sales Associate - Health Insurance. Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable health insurance plans.
Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to overall business growth.
Maintain accurate sales records, customer databases, and daily activity reports.

3. Eligibility Criteria
Minimum: 10+2 / Higher Secondary.
Graduate in any discipline preferred.

Experience:
Freshers with good communication and sales aptitude may apply.
Experience in health insurance, life insurance, banking, financial services, or field sales will be an added advantage.

4. Required Skills
Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Basic understanding of health insurance products or willingness to learn.
Willingness to travel locally for field sales.

5. Compensation and Benefits
Salary: As per company norms and candidate experience.
Attractive sales incentives based on performance, as applicable.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Customer satisfaction and retention.
Policy renewal and referral generation.

7. Candidate Requirements
Strong knowledge of the Meghalaya market and local business environment will be preferred.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of district-level business targets.
Good communication skills in English; knowledge of local/regional languages are Mandatory.

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Manager - Training

The Manager - Training will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing training programs aimed at enhancing the skills and knowledge of employees within the organization. This role involves conducting training needs assessments, designing training materials, and delivering engaging training sessions. The Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure alignment of training programs with company objectives and employee performance metrics. Additionally, the role requires tracking and reporting on training effectiveness and participating in continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Conduct training needs assessments to identify gaps in employee skills and knowledge.
2. Design and develop training programs and materials tailored to various employee groups.
3. Deliver engaging and effective training sessions using various instructional techniques.
4. Collaborate with department heads to ensure training aligns with business goals.
5. Evaluate training effectiveness through surveys, assessments, and performance metrics.
6. Provide coaching and support to employees to reinforce learning outcomes.
7. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in training and development.
8. Manage training budgets and resources efficiently.

Skills and Tools Required:
1. Strong communication and presentation skills.
2. Ability to design and develop training materials and programs.
3. Knowledge of adult learning principles and training methodologies.
4. Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and training software.
5. Analytical skills to assess training effectiveness and make data-driven decisions.
6. Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
7. Project management skills to oversee training initiatives and meet deadlines.
8. Familiarity with performance management systems and tools.
9. Innovative thinking to create engaging and effective training solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
2. Proven experience in training and development within the insurance or financial services industry.
3. Certification in training or instructional design is a plus.

Description:
Job Responsibilities VAPT Engineer
Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) for web applications, APIs, networks, and IT infrastructure.
Conduct authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability assessments to identify security weaknesses.
Execute manual penetration testing to validate vulnerabilities and assess their exploitability.
Use security testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Identify and validate security vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10 risks and common network security weaknesses.
Prepare detailed VAPT reports covering identified vulnerabilities, severity levels, technical evidence, risk impact, and remediation recommendations.
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to support vulnerability remediation.
Perform retesting after remediation and verify vulnerability closure.
Support secure code review and application security assessments.
Maintain VAPT documentation, testing procedures, and assessment records.
Support security compliance audits and assessments in accordance with applicable security standards and organizational policies.
Ensure all penetration testing activities are conducted within the approved scope and follow established security testing methodologies.
Required Technical Skills
Hands-on experience in VAPT and manual penetration testing.
Knowledge of web application, API, network, and infrastructure security testing.
Experience with Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG).
Ability to prepare technical VAPT reports and recommend remediation measures.
Experience with vulnerability validation, remediation tracking, and retesting.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with practical experience executing penetration tests, validating vulnerabilities, preparing technical reports, and conducting remediation retesting are preferred. Candidates with experience limited to GRC, compliance, or reviewing third-party VAPT reports may not be suitable for this hands-on role.

About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To ensure efficient operation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and breakdown maintenance of mechanical equipment in the cement plant, with specific responsibility for crushers and associated material-handling equipment to minimize downtime and ensure smooth plant operations.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Crusher Operation and Maintenance
Perform preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of crushers, including jaw crushers, hammer crushers, impact crushers, and other crushing equipment, as applicable to the plant.
Monitor crusher performance, vibration, temperature, noise, lubrication, and equipment condition to identify potential faults.
Inspect and maintain crusher components, including hammers, blow bars, liners, jaw plates, bearings, shafts, rotors, and drive assemblies.
Identify and troubleshoot mechanical issues related to crushing equipment and ensure timely rectification of breakdowns.
Monitor wear parts and coordinate their replacement to maintain crushing efficiency and equipment availability.
Assist in maintenance and troubleshooting of crusher feed systems, belt conveyors, vibrating screens, feeders, and associated material-handling systems.
Ensure proper alignment, clearance, lubrication, and assembly of crusher components after maintenance activities.
B. Mechanical Maintenance
Execute scheduled preventive maintenance and equipment inspections as per the maintenance plan.
Maintain and troubleshoot mechanical equipment such as conveyors, gearboxes, motors, pumps, fans, bearings, couplings, and hydraulic systems.
Assist in equipment erection, installation, alignment, dismantling, and commissioning activities.
Identify recurring mechanical failures and support root cause analysis to prevent repeated breakdowns.
Ensure the availability of critical spares and maintain records of maintenance activities, breakdowns, and equipment history.
C. Safety and Compliance
Follow plant safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and applicable PPE requirements.
Ensure safe execution of maintenance activities, particularly during crusher inspection, cleaning, and repair.
Identify unsafe conditions and report equipment abnormalities, hazards, and near misses.
Maintain good housekeeping and ensure compliance with plant safety standards.
D. Coordination and Reporting
Coordinate with production, electrical, instrumentation, and other maintenance teams for planned maintenance and breakdown resolution.
Maintain daily maintenance reports, inspection checklists, and breakdown records.
Support efforts to improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and optimize maintenance costs.
2.. Educational Qualification
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
Relevant technical qualifications in mechanical maintenance may be considered based on experience and company requirements.
3. Required Technical Skills
Practical knowledge of crusher maintenance, wear parts, bearings, shafts, lubrication, and drive mechanisms.
Understanding of preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and basic troubleshooting techniques.
Knowledge of conveyors, feeders, gearboxes, couplings, and material-handling equipment.
Ability to read mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and maintenance checklists.
Basic knowledge of maintenance planning, spare parts management, and root cause analysis.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and maintenance reporting systems.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with hands-on experience in crusher maintenance within a cement manufacturing plant, particularly limestone/raw material crushing, are preferred. The candidate should possess sound mechanical troubleshooting skills and the ability to support preventive and breakdown maintenance activities independently under the guidance of the senior maintenance team.

Description:
Operations Manager - The Vanda Hotel
Position: Operations Manager
Location: The Vanda Hotel
Reporting To: General Manager
Experience Required: 7-10 Years in the Hospitality Industry
Salary Package: 75,000 - 80,000 per month
Employment Type: Full-Time
About the Role
The Vanda Hotel is seeking a dynamic and experienced Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day hotel operations, ensure exceptional guest experiences, optimize operational efficiency, and support business growth. The incumbent will work closely with the General Manager and lead all operational departments to maintain high standards of service, profitability, and compliance.
______________
Key Responsibilities
Hotel Operations Management
Oversee daily operations of all hotel departments including Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Maintenance, Security, and Guest Relations.
Ensure smooth functioning of hotel operations while maintaining service excellence.
Monitor occupancy levels, guest satisfaction scores, and operational performance.
Guest Experience & Service Quality
Ensure superior guest service standards and prompt resolution of guest complaints.
Develop and implement service improvement initiatives.
Maintain high hospitality standards aligned with the hotel's brand image.
Team Leadership & People Management
Supervise, mentor, and motivate department heads and operational staff.
Conduct regular staff meetings, training sessions, and performance reviews.
Ensure adequate staffing and efficient workforce utilization.
Financial & Business Performance
Assist the General Manager in achieving revenue and profitability targets.
Monitor departmental budgets, operational costs, and inventory controls.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and revenue enhancement.


Compliance & Safety
Ensure compliance with hotel policies, statutory regulations, health & safety standards, and hospitality industry guidelines.
Conduct regular inspections and audits of hotel facilities and operations.
Maintain proper documentation and operational records.
Vendor & Facility Management
Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and service providers.
Ensure proper maintenance of hotel infrastructure and equipment.
Monitor procurement activities and stock management.
______________
Required Qualifications & Skills
Education
Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Tourism Management, or a related field.
Professional hospitality certifications will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 7-10 years of experience in the hospitality industry.
At least 3-5 years in a managerial or operational leadership role within hotels, resorts, or hospitality establishments.
Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and team management abilities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Sound knowledge of hotel operations and hospitality standards.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Financial acumen and budget management expertise.
Proficiency in hotel management systems and MS Office.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
______________
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Guest Satisfaction Scores
Occupancy and Revenue Performance
Service Quality Standards
Cost Control and Budget Adherence
Employee Productivity and Retention
Compliance and Safety Standards
______________
Compensation & Benefits
Monthly Salary: 75,000 - 80,000

Description:
Location of Job: Ribhoi, Meghalaya
Type of Employment: Contractual for 1 year, renewable basis performance
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Manager

JOB PURPOSE
The Project Coordinator will be responsible for successful implementation of field level activities and will report to Project Manager.

1. Duties and Responsibilities:
The key responsibilities of this position are as given below:

Responsible for implementation of the project activities at the field level and coordination with other external stakeholders at the project area level.
Support the MMU team in mobilizing the community for taking up the MMU services.
Facilitate in compliance with government norms with respect to MMU operations.
Coordinate baseline survey and project monitoring.
Identify Health workers from the community and support their recruitment
process
Support Senior Project Coordinator /Project Manager in preparing MMU movement schedule and ensure effective implementation of all the project activities.
Responsible for tracking of MMUs through GPS tracking and other mechanism.
Prepare all reports and documentation related to the project, such as MIS reports, financial reports, narrative reports, field observation and visit reports, collection and compilation of case studies and photographs.
Coordinate with various departments/institutions like Health Sub Centres (HSCs), Primary Health Centres (PHCs), Community Health Centres (CHCs), PRI members, Women Self Help Groups, Village Health Sanitation and Nutrition Committees etc.
Liaison with Health and other line departments in district and blocks, ensuring their support and involvement in the project activities.
Conduct regular field visits to monitor and the project progress and provide supportive supervision to the teams and village health workers as and when required.
Other tasks which may be assigned by the Project Manager from time to time.

2. Other Indicative Requirements

Educational Qualifications
Graduation in Social Sciences/ any relevant field, preferable to have a diploma or certificate in computer application

Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experiences of more than 3 years, ideally with a public health program or non-profit or organization
Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with strong project management skills.
Demonstrated passion for social impact and development sector.
Good communication and documentation skills in English and Hindi.
Data analysis, reporting and presentation skills.
Leadership and team management skills.
Willingness to travel extensively in remote areas.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Project Identification and Scope
Build and maintain a pipeline of stores, markets or business areas that may require focused project intervention.

2. Business Diagnosis and Opportunity Assessment
Analyse sales, target achievement, market potential, competitor performance, product mix, stock availability, promoter productivity, display, finance penetration and retailer engagement when relevant to the project.
Conduct field visits and structured discussions with store owners, promoters, TLs, Sales, Retail and other teams to identify the actual causes of weak performance.

3. Project Planning
Prepare practical 30-day, 60-day or 90-day project plans with targets, activities, owners, deadlines, resources and expected results.
Recommend project-specific interventions involving manpower, stock, product mix, display, training, finance, retailer schemes, local activation, relationship improvement or process correction.

4. Retailer Negotiation and Stakeholder Alignment
Present the business opportunity and proposed solution to store owners, distributors and other external partners.
Negotiate measurable commitments related to sales, stock investment, display space, promoter placement, branding, finance, local activity or other project requirements.

5. Cross Functional Execution
Coordinate with Sales, Retail, GTM, Marketing, Branding, Training, Affordability, Supply Chain and branch teams according to the needs of each project.

6. Fortress Store and Core Store Projects
Support the opening, ramp-up, performance improvement and turnaround of Fortress Stores.
Lead structured breakthrough projects for high-potential core outlets where vivo has a meaningful opportunity to improve sales or share.

7. Monitoring and Project Closure
Maintain a project tracker covering the baseline, target, actions, owners, deadlines, risks, support required and current status.
Review performance weekly and distinguish completed activity from actual business impact.
Provide concise management updates focused on results, major risks, unresolved dependencies and decisions required.

Preferred candidate profile
Graduate degree in Business, Marketing, Retail Management or a related discipline. An MBA is preferred but not essential.
Four to seven years of relevant experience in smartphones, consumer electronics, telecom, FMCG, retail operations, channel development or field-project execution.
At least two years of experience independently managing store improvement, channel development, territory improvement or another measurable business project.
Evidence of completing projects with a clear baseline, personal actions and measurable before-and-after results.
Experience working with retailers, distributors, promoters or field-sales teams.
Ability to analyse store-level or territory-level data and convert findings into practical actions.
Strong communication, retailer negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple departments even when the project owners do not report directly to the role holder.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including project trackers and business-review presentations.
Willingness to travel frequently and spend significant time in the market.
Good English and Hindi communication. Knowledge of Assamese or other Northeast Indian languages will be an advantage.

At Rongsheng, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We are committed to fostering a culture of integrity, teamwork, innovation, and continuous learning while providing rewarding career opportunities for professionals who aspire to grow in the dynamic mobile and consumer electronics industry.

Join Rongsheng Mobile India Pvt. Ltd. and be a part of a fast-growing organization driving innovation and connectivity across North-East India.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.

Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.

In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.

Description:
1. Background of The Hans Foundation
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust working towards creating an equitable society and enhancing the quality of life of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. THF works to improve the health and wellbeing of remote and underserved populations, with additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women, alongside education and livelihood development.
2. Project Overview: Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre project aims to strengthen access to essential healthcare for rural and hard-to-reach communities in Meghalaya. In its first phase, THF has committed to supporting 50 Sub-Centres through gap assessment, provision of equipment and facilities, deployment of skilled human resources, training, regular operations and monitoring. The project seeks to improve grassroots health services and contribute to better health outcomes, including maternal health.
3. General Information Position MIS Associate Project Hans Health & Wellness Centre (HWC), Meghalaya Location To be specified based on project requirement (e.g., assigned HSC / Project Office) No. of Positions 1 (or as per approved project requirement) Employment Type Contractual for one year; renewable based on performance and project requirements Reporting To Project Manager 4. Key Duties and Responsibilities A. Data Collection, Entry and Management
Collect, compile and enter data received from HSCs in approved registers, Excel sheets, MIS platforms and reporting formats.
Provide data-entry and documentation support to HSC staff, Project Manager and MEL Manager, as required.
Maintain an updated and organised database of HSC-wise service delivery, beneficiary and programme information, as applicable to approved project indicators.
Ensure that records are complete, legible, accurate and updated within prescribed timelines.
B. Data Quality and Verification
Review submitted data for completeness, consistency, duplication, missing entries and obvious errors; seek clarification or corrections from the concerned HSC staff.
Cross-check digital data with source registers and records wherever required.
Maintain proper documentation and an audit trail for corrections and updates; do not alter clinical records without authorisation.
Flag data gaps, discrepancies and delayed submissions to the Project Coordinator for timely resolution.
C. Reporting and MIS
Prepare and submit regular HSC-wise and consolidated project progress reports as per the reporting calendar and formats approved by THF.
Compile monthly and periodic data on service delivery and project indicators, as applicable and approved by the project team.
Support preparation of summary tables, charts, dashboards and presentations for internal reviews and management meetings.
Share verified data with the Project Coordinator and authorised stakeholders within stipulated timelines.
D. Record and Document Management
Maintain and organise registers, reporting files, attendance records and other programme documentation assigned to the role.
Ensure systematic filing, version control, safe storage and timely retrieval of records, in both digital and physical formats.
Support documentation of data-related observations, follow-up actions and reporting submissions.
E. Coordination and Field Support
Coordinate with MLHPs, GNM/ANMs and other HSC personnel to obtain timely and accurate data and clarify reporting requirements.
Follow up on pending reports and support staff in understanding prescribed data formats and reporting timelines.
Participate in project review meetings, trainings and data-verification visits as assigned.
Undertake other MIS, data management and administrative responsibilities relevant to the HWC project, as assigned by the reporting officer.
F. Confidentiality and Compliance
Maintain confidentiality and protect personal and health-related information of beneficiaries in accordance with THF policies and applicable requirements.
Share data only with authorised personnel and use approved systems and formats for storage and transmission.
Adhere to THF policies, professional conduct standards and instructions issued by the project management team.
5. Educational Qualifications
Graduate in any discipline from a recognised institution.
Diploma or certificate in Computer Applications / IT is preferred.
6. Experience and Technical Skills
Preferably 2-3 years of experience in MIS, data entry, reporting, programme support or a related role. Fresh graduates with strong computer skills may also be considered.
Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email and data-entry systems; ability to maintain structured spreadsheets and prepare basic summaries is essential.
Experience in health programmes, public health reporting or work with healthcare facilities would be an advantage.
Ability to check data for accuracy, maintain organised records and meet recurring reporting deadlines.
7. Behavioural and Other Requirements
Good communication, coordination and follow-up skills.
Attention to detail, integrity, reliability and respect for confidentiality.
Ability to work with frontline health staff and manage multiple reporting tasks within deadlines.
Proficiency in English and Hindi; knowledge of the local language/dialect is desirable.
Willingness to travel to assigned HSCs or project locations, as required.
8. Equal Opportunity Statement
The Hans Foundation is an equal opportunity employer and encourages women, persons with disabilities and individuals from economically and socially excluded communities who meet the requisite skills and qualifications to apply. THF does not discriminate on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or any other such matter.

Description:
Field Associate - West Garo Hills (Garo Language)
Location: West Garo Hills, Meghalaya (Onsite)
Experience Level: 1-3 years (Relevant fellowships in enterprise/livelihoods considered)
Salary Band: 5-6 LPA
Job Summary
Ground Zero is looking for an independent, field-driven Field Associate based in West Garo Hills to strengthen women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) through our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). Working directly with community members and state livelihood frameworks, this role provides handholding support in day-to-day business operations, member engagement, governance, procurement, and market linkages across rural enterprises (agri-business, spices, etc.).
Responsibilities
Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize and engage women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business actions, including produce procurement, aggregation, and marketing.
Business Operations & Planning: Help set up ground-level business operations for agri-business and value chains. Coordinate with input suppliers, buyers, transporters, and local service providers.
Governance & Financial Records: Assist PG leaders in maintaining accurate books of accounts, meeting resolutions, governance registers, and financial discipline.
Capacity Building & Training: Facilitate block and district-level training sessions for producer groups and community cadres.
Strategic Linkages & Coordination: Build institutional linkages with local government departments, market actors, and financial institutions under the guidance of the senior team.
Reporting & Field Surveys: Conduct ground-level surveys, market studies, and maintain routine field reports on operational progress, issues, and financials.
Qualifications & Candidate Profile
Education: Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Rural Management, Development Studies, or a related field (Master s/MBA preferred).
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in rural development, SHGs/PGs, collective enterprises, or livelihood promotion. Candidates with recognized fellowships in rural enterprise development will also be considered.

Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.

ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Role Overview
Ground Zero is seeking an energetic Field Associate to empower women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) under our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). Key Competencies: Strong field facilitation skills, basic computer proficiency (MS Excel, Word), and a proactive approach to solving field challenges.
Logistics: Owning a personal two-wheeler/bike is highly preferred for rural movement. Periodic travel to Shillong and Guwahati for strategic reviews will be required.

Job Description

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15+ central and state government partners.

Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.

Set up with support from 90+ eminent philanthropists , 40+ corporates and 15+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and LOreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty-free India, within our lifetime".

What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:

Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale with quality.

What will you do
The/Nudge is working with various state SRLMs to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting vulnerable rural women through community institutions.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and the respective SRLMs
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM) in the respective districts.
Support the district in projects under PVTG Domain.
Coordinate with DMMU and BMMU to ensure smooth implementation of the project .
Coordinate and facilitate in organizing capacity building training of project team and community.
Coordinate and lead in organizing any project related event at regional and district.
Coordinate and support in any field visits of dignitaries and officials.
Ensure timely planning and implementation of project activities.
Ensure proper documentation and reporting related to the project to respective offices.
Facilitate the timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data.
Support and practice monitoring evaluation of projects.
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level.

Who are we looking for in this role
Candidate must be graduate; post-graduate will be preferred, in relevant streams like rural development, rural management, agriculture, forestry, social work, anthropology etc.
Candidate must have 4-6 years of relevant experience in the development sector/ rural development projects/ poverty eradication projects/ livelihood promotion projects/ tribal development projects.
Candidate with work experience working in district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion will be preferred.
The candidate must have her/his own two-wheeler with a valid driving license as it is a field job.
The Location for this role is based in Eastern West Khasi Hills

What s in it for you

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck .

Description:
About Virohan

Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal , Virohan is an education-to-industry partner building the workforce powering India s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry-aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real-world employability.

At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms. Our model combines academic learning with hands-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles. Today, Virohan has trained 13,000+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
Backed by global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan) , we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare - two of India s fastest-growing sectors.

At our core, we are guided by a strong set of values that define how we work, build, and grow together - from ownership and bias for action to empathy, continuous learning, and raising the bar. If you re excited about building something meaningful at scale and solving real-world problems, you ll find yourself at home at Virohan.

Role Overview

The City Admission Manager will own Virohan s end-to-end performance in the assigned city-driving admissions, centre operations, team productivity, student experience, partner coordination, and local brand growth. This person will act as the single accountable business owner for the city, ensuring that all city-level teams deliver against growth, quality, and profitability goals.

What you ll be responsible for

Conduct market surveys alongside competitors.
Identify additional offerings for students.
Establish connections with educational institutions (schools, junior colleges, coaching classes).
Initiate discussions with HODs for seminar opportunities and other BTL activities.
Identify, onboard, and manage channel partners to expand offline sales reach and drive business growth.
Engage students, highlighting Virohans advantages.
Connect with parents during house visits.
Collect data from 12th board exam centers for attracting fresh students.
Plan canopy activities strategically for better outreach.
Plan and execute marketing activities, generating sales leads.
Manage local BTL activities effectively.
Reach monthly sales targets by nurturing agent relationships and networks.

An ideal candidate should have:

Comfortable with field sales; committed to daily market presence.
Proficient in consultative sale, adept at building trust without being forceful.
Capable of handling sales pressures.
Strong communication skills, particularly in regional languages.
Receptive to feedback, embracing learning from mistakes and setbacks.
Presentable appearance and previous fieldwork experience, preferably in education.
Strong presentation skills with the ability to effectively represent the company to diverse audiences.
Holds 2 to 5 years of marketing experience.

Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting the Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited in supporting in day to day commercial activities such as monitoring the billing, collections, identification of energy and revenue leakages etc.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

E. Location:
Shillong, Meghalaya.
The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

Description:
Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.

Support branch management in resolving operational and customer-related issues.

Monitor individual and team productivity.
Conduct regular reviews and capability-building sessions.
Foster a customer-centric culture within the branch.
MIS & Reporting

Prepare periodic reports for management review.
Analyze trends in complaints, service requests, and operational issues.

Company Name: Aditya Tech Mech
Job Location: Silvassa
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Work from Office

About the Company

Aditya Tech Mech is a manufacturer of Diesel Generator (DG) Sets and containers, providing reliable power solutions for industrial and commercial applications. With decades of industry experience, we are committed to delivering quality products, dependable service, and customer satisfaction.

Job Summary
We are looking for a confident, proactive, and target-oriented Sales and Back Office Executive to join our team in Silvassa. The candidate will handle incoming sales enquiries, communicate with prospective customers, understand their requirements, follow up on leads, prepare quotations, and convert enquiries into confirmed orders.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a strong sales mindset, and the ability to manage leads independently from the initial enquiry to the final sales closure.

Key Responsibilities
Handle incoming sales leads and enquiries received through phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and digital marketing platforms.
Contact prospective customers, understand their requirements, and explain the company's products and solutions.
Follow up consistently with potential customers to convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
Prepare and share quotations, proposals, and product information with customers.
Negotiate with customers and coordinate with the internal team to close sales.
Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions, quotations, follow-ups, and order status.
Update the company's CRM or task management system regularly.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely responses to customer enquiries.
Maintain professional relationships with existing and prospective customers.
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to business growth.
Prepare daily and periodic sales reports for the reporting manager.
Perform sales-related back-office activities and documentation as required.

Educational Qualification
BBA or MBA graduates preferred.
Graduates with a strong interest in sales and customer relationship management may also be considered.

Experience
15 years of experience in sales, inside sales, tele sales, or lead management preferred.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong willingness to learn may also apply.
Experience in B2B sales, industrial sales, or manufacturing will be an added advantage.

Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Confidence in communicating with customers over phone calls, WhatsApp, and email.
Strong follow-up, negotiation, persuasion, and sales-closing abilities.
Ability to handle multiple leads and prioritise enquiries effectively.
Basic computer proficiency, including MS Excel, email, and CRM tools.
Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
Self-motivated, customer-focused, and target-driven.
Ability to take ownership of leads and work with minimal supervision.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be evaluated based on:
Timely response to incoming leads.
Consistency and effectiveness of customer follow-ups.
Lead conversion rate and number of orders closed.
Accuracy and regularity of CRM updates and sales reports.
Customer relationship management and overall sales contribution.

Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . Familiar with the operation principle and fault judgment method of large data centre infrastructure (power supply, air conditioning, fire control, security, monitoring, network, etc. ).

Strong sense of responsibility, teamwork, professionalism, and learning ability.
Active and motivated in work, with a good sense of service.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, able to work independently.

Regulatory Compliance: Strictly adhere to staff rules, regulations, and management commands, ensuring careful operation and safe equipment use.
Operational Management: Ensure the normal operation of the hotel s power, water, gas, heating, and cooling equipment.

Emergency Preparedness: Regularly test-run the generator to ensure power generation and transmission during power failures.
Fire Safety Supervision: Supervise and inspect the hotel s fire preventive works, taking measures to stop any violations.
Training & Development: Supervise and train technicians and apprentices, developing their skills.
