Job description of this profile as follows:
Credit Manager will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing the credit risk associated with vehicle loans (including new/used CV loans, two-wheelers, 3-Wheelers, Electric vehicles). This role focuses on assessing creditworthiness, ensuring zero fraud, streamlining loan turn-around-time (TAT), maintaining a healthy portfolio quality, and achieving a sustainable balance between business growth and risk mitigation.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Credit Underwriting & Risk Assessment:
Evaluate loan applications for wheels products based on internal credit policies, financial statements, bank statements, Bureau records (e.g., CIBIL), and field verification reports.
Identify potential red flags, financial stress, or fraudulent documentation early in the underwriting lifecycle.
Assess the buyer's repayment capacity, cash flows (especially for self-employed individuals and commercial operators), and the valuation/LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio of the vehicle being financed.

2. Portfolio Quality & Monitoring:
Track early mortality accounts and manage the non-performing asset (NPA) percentages within the assigned geography or product category.
Monitor monthly bounce rates, overdue accounts, and collection trends to proactively alter credit guidelines if specific segments show high risk.
Conduct periodic portfolio reviews and sample audits of disbursed cases to ensure absolute policy compliance.

3. TAT Management:
Ensuring quick Turn-Around-Time (TAT) from application login to final credit sanction without compromising risk standards.

Key Candidate Requirements:
Candidates should have 4-5 years' experience in credit underwriting of Wheels product.
Relevant experience in credit underwriting within an NBFC or bank.
Good understanding of bureau reports, income assessment, banking analysis, credit policies, and lending processes.
Ability to independently evaluate credit proposals and recommend appropriate credit decisions within delegated authority.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound credit judgment.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and leadership-driven Team Leader to manage a high-performing field sales team in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 5+ years of experience in CV financing, with at least 3-4 years in a supervisory or team-handling role. This position is responsible for driving the team to achieve collective sales targets for used CVs and all new CV products introduced by the company.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
Drive Team Targets: Manage, mentor, and motivate a team of field executives to consistently achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual disbursement targets for Used CV and auxiliary products.
Market Expansion: Identify new market clusters, dealer networks, and broker hubs to expand the companys footprint in the assigned territory.
On-the-Field Joint Calls: Accompany field staff on high-ticket client meetings, complex dealer negotiations, and critical field visits to close deals.
Portfolio Risk Management: Monitor the team's portfolio health, ensure high-quality sourcing, and maintain a low Non-Performing Asset (NPA) / Delinquency rate through rigorous field checks.
Process Compliance: Ensure the team strictly adheres to company credit policies, document verification guidelines, and KYC compliance norms from login to disbursement.
Performance Reviews: Conduct daily/weekly review meetings, track individual executive productivity, and provide continuous on-the-job training.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: Minimum 5 to 8 years of experience in Commercial Vehicle Finance, with a strong preference for used CV market experience. At least 1–2 years of experience managing a field sales team is mandatory.
Education: Graduate / Post-Graduate in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
Leadership Skills: Proven ability to manage, train, and retain a field-oriented sales force.
Analytical Skills: Strong understanding of local asset valuations, credit risk profiles, and market dynamics.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal vehicle for regular field monitoring and dealer visits.
What We Offer
Competitive fixed CTC with team-performance linked incentives / overrides.
Comprehensive travel allowances.
Opportunities to transition into regional management roles.

structure.

institution.

bout the Role
Are you a strategic recruiter who thrives in high-volume, dynamic environments? We are looking for a Recruitment Lead to drive end-to-end frontline manpower hiring across west region. In this role, you will lead high-impact hiring initiatives, optimize sourcing channels, build grassroots partnerships, and ensure a seamless pipeline from candidate selection to onboarding and training.
If you excel at execution, community outreach, and balancing quality with speed, we want to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities
Direct Recruitment Planning (20%)
Review rolling 3-month hiring targets (location, quantity, skill requirements) and develop actionable recruitment plans.
Optimize sourcing channels, combining walk-ins, mass drives, digital recruitment, and specialized outreach programs (e.g., homecoming drives).
Identify resource requirements for hiring events and gain alignment/sign-off with leadership.
Recruitment Process Execution & Monitoring (80%)
Mobilize recruitment teams and lead execution of scheduled hiring drives and events.
Ensure full compliance with internal company policies, statutory regulations, and labor laws governing recruitment.
Issue Letters of Intent (LOI) to selected candidates and actively follow up to ensure seamless transition to training centers with required documentation.
Coordinate directly with training schools on candidate rosters and arrival schedules.
Track hiring event effectiveness, course-correct plans as needed, and maintain accurate recruitment MIS and reporting.
Stakeholders & Relationships
Internal: Hub & Branch Operations Teams, ISM Officers, Recruitment Lead.
External: Prospective candidates, Government/State agencies, Gram Panchayats, local community authorities, and NGOs.
What We Are Looking For
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Graduate degree or equivalent (minimum required).
Experience: 5-7 years of relevant HR experience with a strong background in managing volume recruitment processes.

Job Summary
The opportunity: Associate Consultant-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Ahmedabad
The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility & Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure.
CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organizations ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Demonstrated expertise in executing internal audits across business processes in line with defined audit scope and methodology. Strong capability in conducting process reviews to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and control weaknesses. Proficient in evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls and recommending remediation measures. Skilled in documenting audit findings, process walkthroughs, and control assessments using Microsoft Office tools such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
To qualify for the role you must have
Master of Business Administration
Experience
1 to 2 years
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Description
The opportunity
Design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects, cost-effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards and safety requirements. Based on technical specification from end customers and inputs from OU Engineering team, prepare Protection principle SLD, Schematics substation layouts, sections, Bill of materials, RFQs, vetting of vendor offers, engg hours estimation, visit to project sites, technical risk assessment and opportunity evaluation etc.
How you'll make an impact
Review of Tender document, technical specifications and preparation of Design Intent Document. Preparation of Protection SLD showing principles, relays and meters.
Preparation of Functional Design Standards/Descriptions. Preparation of Signal list, trip matrix, Logics Interlocks.
Review of Vendor drawings and documents (technical vetting of Control Relay panels, Auxiliary System). Preparation of schematic diagrams for the interface's equipment in Control Relay Panel scheme thus providing completeness.
Preparation of relay ordering information and of circuit diagrams - New Existing Set-up (applicable for retrofit projects). Preparation of Cable block diagram.
Preparation of Cable Schedule BoQ estimation for ordering and Wiring/Termination diagrams. Preparation of Core sheets and SCS IO Schedule.
Panel Engineering Expertise (Layouts, circuit diagram, wiring table, terminal table etc.,) preferred. Preparation of Voltage drop calculation - Trip Close coil, LVAC power cable.
Identification of existing drawings and modifying them using red and green markups as per standard requirements. Interface knowledge with Primary Equipment, Bay Controller Units /SCADA/RTU/Tele protection are essential.
Auxiliary Power System design like Low Voltage AC Panel DC Panel requirements, Aux Tr and Battery Charger Sizing, ACDC Cable sizing CB selectivity study, CT / VT Sizing. Relay configuration (Preferred).
Excellent knowledge in AIS GIS secondary designs. As Built documentation. Co-ordination with other departments like primary, lead engineer, sourcing, CR factory counterpart own department control and protection etc. for design progress completion.
Vendor Offer Evaluations. FAT / SAT of primary secondary equipment, system as and when needed. Ensure Ontime delivery of design deliverables to be vigilant on project schedule impacts. Responsible for obtaining customer approvals for the designs and drawings.
Technical risk and opportunity assessment and validation. Take part in customer meetings / site visits for tender/project clarifications. Support and act as interface engineer during erection commissioning.
Estimation of engineering effort for each project for costing at tender stage. Innovative ideas to reduce Engineering effort. Plan, implement, review and continuously improvise quality system.
Ensure the Safety through design principles which meant for complete project lifecycle.
Responsible for maintaining and updating the documentation for respective tenders and projects as per quality process.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
Bachelors Engineering in electrical, should have 2 to 15 years' experience.
Proficiency in required CAD design tools and E3. Knowledge of relevant international standards ex. IEEE, IEC etc.
Knowledge in substation tendering and project engineering activities (technical commercial).
Individual contributor using in-depth knowledge in a specific area to execute complex or specialized projects / challenges often thinking independently to challenge traditional solutions.
Comprehensive knowledge of related disciplines in the organization. Works independently, applying established standards.
Excellent English speaker, good communication skills. Dynamic and Proactive, willing to grow in the organization.
Team player, ready to play the role across the different countries. High level of ownership and able to guide and plan works for the team.
Proficiency in both spoken written English language is required.

Role & responsibilities
We are looking for an entrepreneurial and result-oriented Branch Manager - Gujarat Region to establish and lead our Ahmedabad branch.
The incumbent will have complete responsibility for developing SDS India's business presence across Gujarat, identifying new business opportunities, acquiring strategic customers, building a strong local team and achieving the branch's revenue and profitability targets.

Preferred candidate profile

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of the Gujarat industrial ecosystem, particularly the automotive, pharmaceutical, engineering, chemicals and manufacturing sectors.

This is a leadership position offering an opportunity to build a business from the ground up and establish SDS India as a preferred technology and engineering solutions partner in Gujarat.

Key Responsibilities:

A. Business Development and Growth
Develop and execute the business strategy for SDS India in Gujarat.
Establish and grow the Ahmedabad branch as a regional business centre.
Identify new customers, markets and business opportunities across Gujarat.
Develop strategic relationships with industrial customers, OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers and manufacturing companies.
Drive business growth in automotive, pharmaceuticals, engineering, chemicals and other manufacturing industries.
Develop a strong sales pipeline and ensure achievement of annual revenue and order booking targets.
Identify opportunities for cross-selling and up-selling across SDS India's complete portfolio.
B. Sales and Key Account Management
Develop relationships with CXOs, plant heads, engineering heads, IT heads, automation heads and purchase teams.
Lead customer meetings, business presentations, commercial negotiations and contract closures.
Work closely with Siemens Limited and other technology partners to develop joint business opportunities.
C. Technology and Solution Sales
Promote SDS India's capabilities in:
Drive sale of Siemens automation products viz PLC / HMI / VFD / SCADA / SERVO
Siemens / Rockwell / Mitsubishi PLC, HMI and SCADA solutions.
Industrial automation and control systems.
MES and Manufacturing Intelligence Systems.
IT-OT integration and industrial connectivity.
D. Team Building and Leadership
Build and develop the Gujarat branch team, including sales, business development and technical resources.
Recruit, mentor and motivate team members.
Establish a performance-driven and customer-centric culture.
Define individual responsibilities, performance objectives and measurable KPIs.
Coordinate with the Pune head office for technical resources, project execution and operational support.
E. Branch Operations and Financial Management
Take ownership of branch revenue, profitability and operating expenses.
Prepare annual business plans, budgets and periodic forecasts.
Monitor order booking, revenue, collections, margins and working capital.
Ensure effective coordination between the Ahmedabad branch and the Pune head office.
Maintain appropriate reporting, governance and compliance standards.

Description:
JOB TITLE:CENTRE HEAD

REPORTS TO:OPERATIONS HEAD & REGIONAL HEAD


KEY TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES
Responsible for monitoring the Administrative , Operational and Technical aspects & smooth functioning of the centre as a whole with emphasis on the Slimming and Beauty Sections in the Centres in order to ensure the optimum capacity utilization and quality service delivery to provide client delight:
Documentation: Regular checking and corrective measures for filling of the Client Programme Records and other requisite documents & informing the Corporate Office. Ensure correct and timely software entries, checking them for necessary corrections.
Monitoring Client Progress: Regular monitoring of progress of all clients. Organize periodic meetings with respective departments to resolve general and specific concerns. To interact with all clients (especially those losing slowly/not getting expected results ) personally and coordinate with R & D for further technical inputs, as and when required.
Zero Sessions: Stringent Monitoring to ensure zero sessions are conducted as per SOP and within the stipulated timelines.
Maintain liaison between the Centre and the Corporate Office.
Knowledge transfer and technical inputs from R&D or Corporate Office to the respective Centre staff.
To regularly update oneself on all Obesity / Beauty related research in ones region and share the relevant information pertaining to the same with R & D Dept.
Communication, implementation and compliance of all Corporate policies in the Centre.
Coordinate with Zonal head and Corporate Office in case of delays in the availability of stock - linen, documents, appliances and their accessories, and to ensure all equipment is in working condition at all times.
To take Corporate guidance for booking of complicated Medical Cases.
To take corrective measures, with advice from Corporate Office if required, in case of wrong bookings and medical contraindications.
Executions & Compliance to SOP: To ensure that Centers achieve qualitative and quantitative executions as specified by the Corporate & according to the service delivery parameters given by R&D. To co-ordinate with R&D for any guidance regarding the same. Periodic technical audits and technical reviews of staff to check for compliance with SOP. Take corrective actions at Centre level and inform Corporate Office in case of deviations and refresher training required by the staff.
Trainings : To identify the Training needs of the staff and inform the R & D of the following :
- Training Needs -Fresher / Refresher / Advanced / Skill Gap Analysis / Other parameters requiring improvement on individual basis
- To ensure stringent compliance of the Training Nomination SOP w.r.t Training Nomination
Letter / Mandatory signing of Training Agreements by complete staff / Action on Non compliance
- To ensure that the post Training Implementation feedback form is filled up for respective profiles as and when required and sent back to R & D
- To ensure that the identified Centre staff ( Profilewise ) takes keen interest in the improvement of average
performers and feedback of the same sent to the R & D




Review the appointment planner: For optimum utilisation of infrastructure, staff and appliances.
- To review and ensure that the Daily Monitoring Format is correctly and completely filled up and sent to the Corporate within the stipulated time line.
Follow-up of irregular clients: Regular monitoring of client follow-up data wherever required and self follow-up for special clients including VIPs and Doctors.
Unsuccessful but regular clients: Implementation of the specific technical inputs, including counseling of such clients and co-ordinate with Corporate Office for further technical inputs as and when required. To try and keep the percentage of USR clients within the minimum limit as specified by the Corporate.
Validity Expiry: Monitoring of validities for calculations and informing the Corporate Office for any deviation and personal counseling of those clients who were regular but still could not complete the package. To try and expedite that the programme of maximum clients are completed within validity.
Transfer/Conversion of Clients Progamme: Ensure that transfers/ conversions of the clients programme, if any, happen with the consent & coordination of client and the respective CH/AH. In case of inter centre transfers, to ensure transfer of client papers and credit note is done within 48 hours / before client approaches the concerned centre.
Client complaints: Resolve escalated client issues and proactively initiate and reduce possible causes of complaints by customers. To ensure any client complaints is resolved within the next 7 days in case corporate intervention is required, else to resolve within the next 48 hours at the centre level itself. To ensure complete and fair compliance of the Customer Complaint SOP
Staff:
Recruitment and Induction: To ensure that the recruitments are done as per the specified SOP and to conduct the Induction of the new recruits as per designation wise Induction Schedules and to conduct induction sessions as specified for different profiles (Dietician / Slimming Head / Physiotherapist / Doctor / Beauty Head / Beauty Incharge / Hair Stylist / Pedicurist / Dermatologist)

Induction: To assist in the recruitment of new Centre staff , conduct preliminary technical interviews of candidates in case of vacancy and forward for approval to Corporate Office.
Orientation of Staff: To impart on-the-job training at Centre level, to new staff and send their periodic assessment to Corporate Office as specified in the SOP.
Vacancies / TNA : Update the Corporate Office/Zonal Head periodically on the status for vacancies and training needs of the staff.
Sales: Work with Sales team members & Slimming / Beauty In-charges to ensure meeting of in-house sales targets that may be set from time to time. To give realistic sales targets to individual staff members and monitor the same on a daily basis aiming towards the achievement of centres sales target.
Events: To coordinate with the Corporate in giving technical support to the Centre for organizing the Events and sending feedback of the same to the Corporate. Two main events to be planned out and conducted every quarter, in co-ordination with the Corporate.
Software entries: To ensure timely entries of data in the software and monitor the same. To send required data to IT department within the time line specified by the Corporate. On the basis of feedback given by the Corporate, actions to be immediately implemented and revertal on same given to the Corporate.
Staff Attrition: To ensure that the staff attrition does not overshoot a maximum limit as specified by the Corporate. To ensure that all relevant contracts are in place for all staff members.
To ensure optimum staff strength at the Centre at all times keeping in mind the influx and lean hours






KEY ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES

Sops: To ensure adherence & compliance to standard operating procedures at all times and to also ensure that standards are
driven by the Center Manager(s) while providing ownership value.
To oversee achievement of budgeted sales target every month & offer timely advice to team to review strategies to close sales & generate bookings more effectively and scientifically.
Events: To review in consultation with Zonal head & Corporate approval events / promotions planned, local ads to be released and unique packages formulated to match variety of budgets, in order to create & drive awareness about VLCC as a slimming, beauty & fitness ( Wellness ) brand.
To ensure that the data on Centre level Marketing initiative / feedback is collated and analyzed and the same sent to the Head Marketing, Corporate and Regional VP Operations
To promote WOL, family card or any other promotional programs / schemes that the corporate might launch from time to time.
To monitor SMS data / Call Centre escalated queries / Alive Chat mails or any other marketing activities promoted by the marketing department at the corporate.
To oversee monthly budget of the centre & team operations to bring down non-essential overhead costs without impacting quality of service.
To monitor the effectiveness of yield/capacities in the centers and systems to ensure revenues are maximized and provide feedback to senior management
To oversee duty roster & identify staff capable of multitasking and sending them for respective trainings for upgradation.
Monthly/Dailly staff meetings: To help settle personnel grievances through a rational & open meeting or use personal discretion to intervene directly. To ensure that they are held on a monthly basis and to send the reports to the Corporate within the defined time line.
To provide ongoing information and status reports to Regional Operations Head / Senior management team in the corporate on monthly basis on financial and operational performance of center(s).
To oversee management & maintenance of all client records, attendance record, MIS reports, security arrangements, inventory control, compliance to all statutory obligations such as PF, ESIC, Bonus etc..
Checklists: To inspect the center by taking rounds and ensure that the upkeep is as per standard norms and the hygiene and sanitation conditions are par excellence. In addition ensure that machines are in working order. To fill the checklists on a monthly basis and forward the same to the Corporate within the stipulated time line.
To explain the details of incentive plan / salary break up and regularly coordinate with HR on timely distribution of salaries and incentives to the center staff.
To put forth recommendations to corporate office for centre renovation, relocation/ termination of manpower, and closure of certain sections of centre & discontinuing use of certain machines
To conduct regular checks at the center to ensure consumption of products as per SOP and services executed at the centers and FIFO policy is being adhered to for product consumption / retail chain.
To constantly upgrade oneself so as to achieve the progression level as per the multitasking / up gradation planner


Additional Responsibilities:

To offer assistance in pre opening activities of new centers by finalization of floor maps, appliances, consumables, gadgets etc for centers (new and renovations) with approval from corporate office.

To train and groom the next identified successor as Centre Head ( staff identified from within the Centre team )

3. In addition to the above mentioned duties and job functions, to carry out any other assignment given occasionally by the Regional Operations Head.

While the above encapsulates all their responsibilities, the following needs a special mention and should be done on priority basis .
To ensure cleanliness, hygiene and maintenance of the center.
Regular reports on problems observed, actions to be taken and deadlines for the same.
Special focus on service delivery, customer care, satisfaction, delight and feedback.
Cash checking To ensure systematic cash handling and maintenance of cash register . Physical cash and entries in the cash register should match. Report to be sent on any variation to all concerned.

Company: Secure Meters Limited
Location: Sanand, Gujarat
Position: Plumber - ETP/STP Maintenance
Experience: 1-3 Years

About the Role
Secure Meters Limited is looking for a skilled and dedicated Plumber to support the maintenance and smooth operation of the Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) and Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) at our Sanand facility. The candidate will be responsible for plumbing maintenance, troubleshooting, and ensuring uninterrupted plant operations.

Key Responsibilities
Carry out preventive and breakdown maintenance of ETP/STP pipelines, valves, pumps, and plumbing systems.

Install, replace, and maintain water supply and drainage pipelines.
Monitor and maintain pumps, valves, fittings, and associated equipment.
Support ETP/STP operational teams during maintenance activities.
Ensure proper functioning of water distribution and wastewater systems.
Maintain records of maintenance activities and report abnormalities.
Adhere to all safety, environmental, and company guidelines.
Assist in plant utility maintenance as required.

Qualifications
ITI in Plumbing or equivalent technical qualification preferred.
Basic knowledge of ETP/STP systems and utility maintenance.
Ability to use plumbing tools and maintenance equipment safely.

Experience
1 to 3 years of experience in plumbing maintenance, preferably in industrial plants, ETPs, STPs, or utility operations.

Skills Required
Plumbing installation and maintenance
Pipe fitting and repair
Knowledge of pumps, valves, and water treatment systems
Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Basic understanding of safety practices in industrial environments

Preferred Candidate Profile
Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments.
Willingness to work in shifts if required.
Team player with a proactive approach toward maintenance activities.

Role & Responsibilities
Multi-Modality Reporting: Perform, interpret, and generate highly accurate clinical reports for a comprehensive range of diagnostic modalities, including MRI, CT, Ultrasound, X-ray, and Mammography.

Cross-Specialty Collaboration: Partner closely with referring physicians, surgeons, and oncologists to discuss complex cases, offer diagnostic clarity, and guide patient treatment plans.

Interventional Procedures: Perform basic non-vascular interventional procedures (e.g., USG/CT-guided biopsies, FNACs, and fluid aspirations) as required.

Experience:1-5+ years of post-qualification experience working in a high-volume, multi-modality hospital or diagnostic center.
Technical Expertise: Demonstrated competence in independently managing a mixed daily workload of advanced MRI, multi-slice CT, and high-resolution ultrasound/Doppler scans.
Analytical Skills: Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to synthesize complex imaging findings into clear, actionable, and structured reports.
Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to effectively consult with clinical teams and explain procedures empathetically to patients when necessary.
Perks and Benefits
Financial Package: Highly competitive tax-free salary or lucrative revenue-sharing models, supplemented by annual performance-linked bonuses.
Work-Life Balance: Structured, predictable shift timings with minimal on-call rotations and comprehensive paid time off (PTO).
Professional Development: Generous annual CME allowances, sponsorship for international medical conferences, and access to advanced sub-specialty training.
Relocation Support: Comprehensive relocation allowance, housing assistance, and family healthcare coverage.
Technology & Environment: Opportunity to work in a state-of-the-art facility equipped with the latest high-field MRI scanners, ultra-high-speed CT systems, and advanced AI-assisted reporting tools.

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.


Role Summary
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV). Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate. Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Role :
To drive new business growth and revenue for the life insurance company by recruiting, training, managing, and retaining a dedicated network of tied insurance advisors/agents

Key Responsibilities
Advisor Recruitment: Prospect, interview, select, and appoint new life insurance advisors/agents to build a strong, active agency force.
Sales Target Achievement: Drive and monitor monthly, quarterly, and annual premium collection and policy issuance targets through the assigned advisor team.
Training & Enablement: Train, coach, and develop advisors on life insurance products, pitching, objection handling, and digital sales tools/CRM portals.
Advisor Activation & Retention: Ensure active participation (activation) of recruited agents, conduct regular huddles/meetings, and drive retention to lower agent attrition.
Compliance & Quality: Maintain high standards of business ethics, ensure proper customer documentation, prevent policy lapses/fraud, and adhere to IRDAI (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India) guidelines.
Customer Servicing: Assist agents and policyholders with post-sales service, renewals, claims support, and grievance handling.
AboutCompany:
Axis Max Life Insurance, one of the leading non-bank promoted private life insurers, is a joint venture between Axis Max Services Ltd. and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co. Ltd. Axis Max Services Ltd. is part of the Axis Max Group, which is a leading Indian multi-business corporation, while Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance is a member of the MS&AD Insurance Group, which is amongst the leading insurers in the world.

Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive long term savings, protection and retirement solutions through its high quality agency distribution and multi-channel distribution partners. A financially stable company with a strong track record over the last 20 years, Axis Max Life offers superior investment expertise. Axis Max Life has the vision 'To be the most admired life insurance company by securing the financial future of our customers'. The company has a strong customer-centric approach focused on advice-based sales and quality service delivered through its superior human capital.

During the financial year 2018-19, Axis Max Life achieved ‘Gross Written Premium’ of Rs. 14,575 crore & had sum assured in force of Rs. 7,03,972 Crore. As on 31st March 2019, the Company had Rs. 62,798 crore of AUM & a share capital including reserves & surplus of Rs. 2,767 crore. The Company has nearly 35 lakh customers serviced by its 12,082 employees & 48,522 agent advisors through 269 offices across the country.

Description:
AEL is DMarts ecommerce venture which is engaged in the business of online grocery retail under the brand name DMart Ready. AEL currently operates its business in select areas of Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat & is poised to launch its operations in Indore & Bhopal. Platform Automation Developer - Kubernetes, Python, PowerShell Shell
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Noida / Hyderabad / Chennai

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Platform Automation Developer with strong expertise in Kubernetes, Python, PowerShell, and Shell scripting. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building platform-level automation solutions that enable deployment, configuration, packaging, orchestration, and lifecycle management of applications across Linux, Windows, VM, and containerized environments.


Your Role
As a Platform Automation Developer, you will design and develop automation frameworks, orchestration services, deployment tooling, and platform utilities that improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. You will work closely with DevOps, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application teams to deliver robust automation solutions.


Key Responsibilities
Develop platform-level automation and orchestration components for deployment, configuration, packaging, and management of application workloads.
Build automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, Bash/Shell, and related technologies.
Automate application installation, configuration, service management, environment setup, and health validation processes.
Develop and maintain container images, Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, and deployment packages.
Create build, release, and packaging automation for Linux and Windows-based applications.
Develop PowerShell automation for Windows workloads and Python/Shell automation for Linux environments.
Integrate automation components with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) frameworks.
Implement logging, monitoring, validation, exception handling, rollback, and retry mechanisms within automation workflows.
Develop APIs, CLI tools, and platform services to support automated provisioning and environment management.
Implement secure handling of credentials, certificates, secrets, and configuration parameters.


Required Skills Experience
6+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Automation Development, DevOps, or Infrastructure Automation.
Strong programming experience in Python.
Hands-on expertise in PowerShell and Bash/Shell scripting.
Strong experience with Kubernetes administration, deployment, and troubleshooting.
Experience creating and maintaining Helm Charts, Kubernetes manifests, and containerized deployments.
Knowledge of Docker containerization and image management.
Experience integrating automation with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code concepts and automation frameworks.
Experience developing APIs, command-line tools, or automation services.

JOB TITLE: Senior Design Manager (Architecture)
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Tribeca is the largest branded luxury developer in India! Established in 2012, we have grown to become the largest developer of Trump-branded properties in the world (after the Trump Organization). Our current employee strength comprises more than 250+ associates across Mumbai, Pune, Delhi-NCR, Kolkata, and Bangalore, and we have a team of incredibly talented, hungry, bright, and passionate folks, including IIT, IIM, Wharton, and SPA toppers and industry stalwarts.

At Tribeca, we are focused on creating world-class products and customer experiences. We pioneered the concept of branded residences in India and are developing over 6 million square feet of branded residential projects in India. We are also proud to be developing the world's largest rooftop terrace.

ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for an experienced architect to lead design development and consultant coordination for our residential, mixed-use, and redevelopment projects across India. The role combines hands-on design work, from early-stage building massing through design refinement, with the management of a multidisciplinary consultant team. The ideal candidate understands Indian building regulations across different states and cities, and can translate local regulatory constraints into efficient, marketable design solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Massing
Prepare building massing studies and design options at the feasibility and concept stage, optimising FSI/FAR, unit mix, and aleable area within the applicable local regulations.
Review and refine architectural designs at each stage to improve planning efficiency, buildability, and product quality.
Evaluate design proposals from consultants and suggest improvements aligned with project and business objectives.

Consultant Coordination
Coordinate with all project consultants, including the Architect, Structural, MEP, Landscape, Rendering, and Model Making agencies, across multiple project locations.
Conduct design review meetings, track action items, and ensure timely delivery of drawings and deliverables.
Ensure design integration across disciplines and resolve conflicts between architectural, structural, and services drawings.

Regulatory Compliance
Ensure designs comply with the National Building Code (NBC 2016) and the development control regulations of the respective state or city, such as DCPR 2034 (Mumbai), UDCPR (Maharashtra), and building bye-laws of other states and development authorities.
Quickly study and interpret the local regulations applicable to new project locations.
Factor in statutory requirements such as fire NOC norms, height clearances (AAI), environmental clearance, and RERA area definitions at the design stage.
Support the approval process by reviewing submission drawings and addressing authority queries in coordination with the liaison team.

Document and Data Management
Maintain an organised folder structure for all project design documentation.
Keep a drawing register tracking all files received from and issued to consultants, including revisions and dates.
Ensure version control so that the team always works from the latest approved drawings.

Presentation and Visualisation
Prepare design presentations for management review and decision-making.
Coordinate renders, walkthroughs, and physical models for marketing and approvals, and use 3D and AI rendering tools for quick design visualisation.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelors degree in Architecture (B.Arch); registration with the Council of Architecture is preferred.
Minimum 7 years of experience in an architectural or design firm, preferably on high-rise residential, mixed-use, or redevelopment projects.
Working knowledge of NBC 2016 and development control regulations in at least one major Indian city, with the ability to adapt to regulations in other states.

MANDATORY SOFTWARE SKILLS

AutoCAD
SketchUp
Adobe Photoshop

Description:
Job Description: Senior Oracle DBA / Exadata & Multi-Cloud DBA

Experience
815+ years of Oracle Database Administration experience, with strong hands-on expertise in enterprise, high-availability, mission-critical database environments.
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Oracle Database Administrator (DBA) with deep expertise in Oracle Exadata, RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, GoldenGate, Performance Tuning, Backup & Recovery, Patching and Database Cloning.
The candidate should also have hands-on experience managing Oracle database workloads across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). The role requires strong troubleshooting capabilities, performance optimization skills, high-availability and disaster-recovery expertise, automation mindset, and experience supporting large-scale production database environments.
Key Responsibilities
Oracle Database Administration
Install, configure, upgrade, maintain, and troubleshoot Oracle Database 11g/12c/18c/19c/23ai environments.
Manage both single-instance and RAC databases across production and non-production environments.
Perform database provisioning, refreshes, migrations, upgrades, and cloning.
Manage tablespaces, datafiles, redo logs, archive logs, control files, undo, temporary tablespaces, and database storage.
Perform proactive database health checks, capacity planning, and availability monitoring.
Troubleshoot complex production incidents and perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Oracle Exadata
Strong hands-on administration and troubleshooting experience with Oracle Exadata Database Machine.
Experience supporting Exadata database nodes, storage cells, ASM, RAC, and high-availability configurations.
Monitor and troubleshoot Exadata performance using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, cell metrics and Exadata-specific statistics.
Understand Exadata technologies including:
Smart Scan
Storage Indexes
Smart Flash Cache
I/O Resource Management
Cell Offload Processing
Hybrid Columnar Compression
Experience with Exadata patching and maintenance activities.
Oracle RAC & Clusterware
Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Oracle RAC and Grid Infrastructure.
Troubleshoot RAC node eviction, CRS failures, interconnect issues, voting disk/OCR issues, and cluster resource failures.
Manage services, listeners, SCAN listeners, VIPs, and RAC database services.
Perform RAC rolling maintenance and patching with minimum business disruption.
ASM & Storage
Install, configure, and administer Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
Manage ASM disk groups, failure groups, rebalance operations, disk additions/removals, and storage capacity.
Troubleshoot ASM, multipathing, storage latency, and database I/O issues.
RMAN, Backup & Recovery
Design, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot RMAN backup and recovery strategies.
Strong experience with:
Full and incremental backups
Archive log backups
Control file and SPFILE recovery
Database restore and recovery
Point-in-Time Recovery
Tablespace recovery
Block Media Recovery
Disaster recovery scenarios
Perform regular recovery validation and ensure compliance with defined RPO/RTO requirements.
Oracle Data Guard
Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Oracle Data Guard / Active Data Guard.
Manage physical standby databases and Data Guard Broker.
Perform and troubleshoot switchover and failover operations.
Monitor redo transport and apply lag.
Troubleshoot archive gaps, redo transport failures, standby synchronization, and recovery issues.
Experience with disaster recovery testing and DR drills.
Oracle GoldenGate
Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Oracle GoldenGate replication.
Configure and manage:
Extract
Data Pump
Replicat
Integrated Extract
Integrated Replicat
Trail files
Checkpoints
Troubleshoot replication lag, abends, missing transactions, mapping issues, and data inconsistencies.
Experience with zero/minimal-downtime database migrations using GoldenGate is highly desirable.
Performance Tuning
Strong expertise in Oracle database and SQL performance tuning.
Analyze AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, wait events and system statistics.
Troubleshoot:
High CPU utilization
I/O bottlenecks
Memory pressure
Blocking/locking
RAC contention
SQL performance degradation
Database hangs
Connection storms
Tune SQL statements, optimizer statistics, indexing strategies, SGA/PGA parameters, and database configuration.
Patching & Upgrades
Perform Oracle Database and Grid Infrastructure patching.
Experience with RU/RUR/one-off patches and OPatch/OPatchAuto.
Perform pre-patch validation, rollback planning, post-patch validation, and troubleshooting.
Experience performing Oracle database upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
Database Cloning & Refresh
Perform database cloning and environment refresh using:
RMAN Duplicate
Backup-based cloning
Active Duplicate
Data Pump
Snapshot/Storage-based techniques
Experience with large production-to-non-production database refreshes.
Implement appropriate security and masking processes where production data is copied to lower environments.
Cloud DBA Experience
AWS
Hands-on experience managing Oracle databases on Amazon Web Services (AWS), preferably:
Amazon RDS for Oracle
Oracle on EC2
EBS storage
S3
AWS Backup
CloudWatch
IAM
Multi-AZ/DR architecture
Database migration using AWS DMS
Ability to troubleshoot database performance, storage, connectivity, backup, recovery, and availability issues in AWS environments.
Microsoft Azure
Experience managing Oracle database workloads hosted on Microsoft Azure, including:
Oracle databases on Azure Virtual Machines
Azure Storage
Managed Disks
Azure Backup
Azure Monitor
Networking/NSG
Availability Zones/Sets
Oracle Database@Azure exposure is desirable.
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
Strong Oracle database administration experience in OCI, preferably:
Base Database Service
Exadata Database Service
Exadata Cloud@Customer
Autonomous Database exposure
OCI Compute
Block/Object Storage
OCI IAM
VCN/networking
OCI Monitoring
Backup and Recovery
Data Guard/DR configurations
Experience performing on-premises-to-cloud and cloud-to-cloud Oracle database migrations is highly desirable.
Automation & Scripting
Strong scripting knowledge in:
Shell/Bash
SQL/PLSQL
Python
Experience automating database health checks, backup validation, monitoring, patching, provisioning, and operational activities.
Exposure to Ansible, Terraform, OCI CLI, AWS CLI, or Azure CLI is desirable.
Exposure to AI/agentic automation for database operations is an added advantage.

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the world's leading organizations


Your role

Experience: 0 to 1 years post qualification
Qualification: CA 2026
At our GIA Department, we adopt an independent, systematic, and disciplined approach to evaluate and enhance risk management, control, and governance processes across our strategic business units, business units, and functions such as Sales, Delivery, Finance, Procurement, and HR. We are recognized as the catalyst for strengthening our organization's control performance.
Joining our diverse GIA team, composed of approximately 30 multilingual staff, you will have the opportunity to work under the leadership of our Group Chief Audit Officer (CAO) in two vibrant locations: Paris, France, and Mumbai, India. As a valued member of our team, you will enjoy direct interaction with the Leadership team, including the CEO, CFO, CIO, and more, offering you valuable exposure and the chance to contribute to the success of the Capgemini Group.
This role presents exciting prospects for travel and networking, as you will collaborate with team members from different countries and functions. With up to 50%-60% of your time spent outside of India, visiting our Capgemini businesses in over 25 countries, you will broaden your horizons and enhance your professional network. Expect approximately two working weeks of travel per month, with up to 8-10 international trips per year. During the remaining time, you will conduct audits in India, either with domestic travel or based from our Mumbai office.
Working within a multicultural business environment, you will gain extensive knowledge of Group operations across various business units, allowing you to develop expertise in specific domains. This experience will provide you with a strong understanding of overall business processes, making you a sought-after professional in the industry.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills are essential, enabling you to effectively communicate with stakeholders at all levels.



Your Profile

As a GIA Team Member, your responsibilities will include:
performing internal audit assignments,
mapping processes,
identifying process-level controls, and
assessing the design and effectiveness of financial, operational, and compliance processes

About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.
Counsel prospective learners about upGrads programs, courses, eligibility, and career benefits.
Follow up with leads and convert prospective learners into enrolled students.
Achieve assigned monthly admission and revenue targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups and build strong relationships with prospective learners.
Handle queries and objections related to programs, fees, eligibility, and career outcomes.
Maintain accurate lead and conversion records in the CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission and enrollment process.

0-3 years of experience in Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Admission Counseling, Telesales, or Business Development.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable learning programs.
Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.
Candidates from EdTech, Education, BFSI, Telecom, or other sales-driven industries are preferred.

Description:
Role & Responsibilities
Handle customer Purchase Orders (POs) and ensure accurate order processing.
Verify product details, quantities, pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules.
Coordinate with Production, Planning, QA, QC, Stores, Accounts, and Dispatch teams for timely order execution.
Monitor pending orders and dispatch schedules and ensure timely delivery to customers.
Prepare and maintain customer-wise pending PO reports, order tracking sheets, and sales MIS.
Communicate order status, production updates, and dispatch commitments to customers.
Coordinate preparation of invoices, packing lists, COA, and other dispatch-related documents.
Handle customer queries related to order status, dispatch, and delivery.
Follow up on customer payments and outstanding invoices in coordination with Accounts.
Maintain proper records of customer orders, amendments, and dispatch details.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Graduate in B.Sc., B.Com, B.Pharm, MBA (Marketing), or equivalent qualification.
Good communication and customer relationship management skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel, ERP systems, and sales documentation.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-up abilities.
Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple departments and manage customer orders efficiently.
Perks and Benefits
Competitive salary as per industry standards.
Opportunity to work with a growing pharmaceutical manufacturing organization.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.
Supportive and collaborative work environment.
Exposure to domestic and international pharmaceutical business operations.
Performance-based growth opportunities.



Perks and benefits
Health insurance, Provident fund, Gratuity, Mobile bill reimbursements
AboutCompany:
Integrin Life Sciences is a pharmaceutical manufacturing company engaged in the development and manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), advanced pharmaceutical intermediates and pharmaceutical pellets. Established in 2013, the company operates from Hyderabad with its manufacturing facility located in Jaggaiahpet, Andhra Pradesh.
The company serves pharmaceutical customers across domestic and international markets, with a focus on quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing excellence and customer satisfaction. Integrin Life Sciences operates with GMP and WHO-GMP compliant manufacturing practices and has capabilities across multiple therapeutic segments.

(GMV) per month.

specific geographies assigned

Interaction with Stakeholders:

reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English

Effective communication skills

Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Description:
Role & Responsibilities Regional Sales Manager (Punjab)
Develop and execute regional sales strategies to drive business growth across Punjab.
Identify and develop new business opportunities through boutiques, multi-brand outlets (MBOs), retailers, resellers and distributors.
Expand the brand's retail and wholesale network across key cities such as Ludhiana, Amritsar, Jalandhar, Patiala, Bathinda and Chandigarh.
Build and maintain strong relationships with boutique owners, fashion retailers, wedding stores and distributors.
Generate B2B, wholesale, bulk, bridal and occasion-wear orders.
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual regional sales targets.
Identify potential retail partners and negotiate commercial terms, margins and business agreements.
Conduct regular market visits, client meetings, store visits and competitor analysis.
Manage existing accounts, ensure repeat orders and develop long-term business relationships.
Identify local exhibitions, trade fairs, fashion events and networking opportunities to generate business.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing and customer preferences.
Manage and follow up on leads, enquiries, quotations, orders and payments.
Coordinate with the head office, founders and internal teams for smooth order execution and customer satisfaction.
Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports covering revenue, new accounts, leads, orders and market performance.
Take ownership of regional business expansion and brand presence across Punjab


Preferred Candidate Profile
5 + years of experience in Regional Sales, Area Sales, Business Development or B2B Sales.
Experience in fashion, apparel, ethnic wear, women's wear, bridal wear, jewellery or lifestyle brands preferred.
Strong understanding of the Punjab retail and wholesale market.
Existing network of boutiques, multi-brand outlets, retailers, resellers and distributors across Punjab will be an advantage.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets and generating new business.
Experience in wholesale sales, bulk orders, distributor management and retail expansion.
Strong negotiation, client acquisition and relationship management skills.
Ability to independently develop new markets and generate business.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Fluent in Punjabi and Hindi; workable English preferred.
Willingness to travel extensively across Punjab for client meetings and market development.
Self-driven, target-oriented and capable of working independently
Own vehicle preferred.
Candidates based in Punjab or with strong existing Punjab market connections preferred.

About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: QMS Engineer / Quality Management System Engineer
Department: Quality Management
To establish, maintain, and continuously improve the Quality Management System in compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, and internal standards. Support internal audits, process audits, supplier quality management, and continuous improvement activities.
Key Responsibilities
Quality Management System (QMS): Maintain and improve QMS documentation as per IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 requirements.
Monitor compliance with quality procedures, work instructions, and standard operating procedures.
Coordinate management review meetings and track action closures.
Maintain document control and record retention systems.
Plan and conduct Internal System Audits.
Plan and conduct Process Audits (VDA 6.3).
Plan and conduct Layered Process Audits (LPA).
Plan and conduct Product Audits.
Support certification audits conducted by external agencies.
Coordinate customer audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
Track corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) arising from audits.
Monitor manufacturing process compliance and effectiveness.
Analyze quality KPIs and identify improvement opportunities.
Lead root cause analysis using 8D Methodology, 5 Why Analysis, Ishikawa Diagram.
Drive continuous improvement and error-proofing activities.
Support supplier assessments and qualification activities.
Participate in supplier process audits and supplier development programs.
Monitor supplier quality performance: PPM, Delivery Quality, Audit Scores.
Follow up on supplier corrective actions and 8D reports.
Coordinate with purchasing and supplier quality teams for issue resolution.
Support compliance with: IATF 16949, ISO 9001, VDA Standards, Customer Specific Requirements (CSR).
Ensure timely implementation of customer quality requirements.
Facilitate Kaizen and quality improvement projects.
Support lessons learned implementation.
Promote quality awareness across departments.
Your Qualifications
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Industrial, or Automotive Engineering.
3-8 years of experience in Automotive Quality/QMS.
Technical Competencies
IATF 16949
ISO 9001
VDA 6.3 Process Audit
VDA 6.5 Product Audit
APQP
PPAP
FMEA
8D Problem Solving
Six Sigma Green Belt

AboutCompany:
Axis Max Life Insurance, one of the leading non-bank promoted private life insurers, is a joint venture between Axis Max Services Ltd. and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co. Ltd. Axis Max Services Ltd. is part of the Axis Max Group, which is a leading Indian multi-business corporation, while Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance is a member of the MS&AD Insurance Group, which is amongst the leading insurers in the world.

Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive long term savings, protection and retirement solutions through its high quality agency distribution and multi-channel distribution partners. A financially stable company with a strong track record over the last 20 years, Axis Max Life offers superior investment expertise. Axis Max Life has the vision 'To be the most admired life insurance company by securing the financial future of our customers'. The company has a strong customer-centric approach focused on advice-based sales and quality service delivered through its superior human capital.

During the financial year 2018-19, Axis Max Life achieved ‘Gross Written Premium’ of Rs. 14,575 crore & had sum assured in force of Rs. 7,03,972 Crore. As on 31st March 2019, the Company had Rs. 62,798 crore of AUM & a share capital including reserves & surplus of Rs. 2,767 crore. The Company has nearly 35 lakh customers serviced by its 12,082 employees & 48,522 agent advisors through 269 offices across the country.

Description:
A. Sample Collection & Processing
Collect, receive, label, and process patient samples as per laboratory protocols.
Ensure proper sample identification, handling, storage, and disposal.
Check samples for adequacy and reject unsuitable samples as per SOPs.
Maintain accurate sample records and ensure timely processing.
B. Laboratory Testing & Analysis
Perform routine diagnostic tests as per assigned laboratory section.
Handle and operate laboratory instruments and diagnostic equipment.
Prepare reagents, stains, and other laboratory materials as required.
Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure accurate and reliable test results.
Ensure timely completion of tests and communicate critical issues to the supervisor.
C. Equipment Maintenance
Perform routine cleaning, calibration checks, and maintenance of laboratory instruments.
Monitor equipment performance and report breakdowns or technical issues promptly.
Maintain equipment usage logs and maintenance records.
Ensure proper storage and handling of reagents, kits, and consumables.
D. Quality Control & Compliance
Perform internal quality control (IQC) as per established procedures.
Follow laboratory quality standards, safety guidelines, and applicable SOPs.
Maintain proper documentation for quality control, testing, and equipment maintenance.
Support internal audits and accreditation-related activities, wherever applicable.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Ensure uninterrupted, safe and efficient operation of plant utilities, including boilers, chillers, cooling towers, compressors, nitrogen systems, HVAC and water systems.
Plan and execute preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance to minimize equipment downtime.
Ensure timely availability of steam, chilled water, cooling water, compressed air, nitrogen and other utilities as per production requirements.
Monitor utility consumption, optimize energy efficiency and implement cost-reduction initiatives.
Ensure compliance with cGMP, SOPs, statutory requirements and EHS standards.
Monitor critical operating parameters and equipment performance to ensure system reliability.
Coordinate qualification, calibration, validation and documentation of utility systems.
Manage utility installation, commissioning, capacity enhancement and improvement projects.
Ensure statutory inspections, safety compliance and risk mitigation for utility equipment.
Supervise utility personnel and contractors, ensuring effective deployment and technical competency.
Manage maintenance budgets, spare parts inventory, AMCs and utility-related expenditures.
Coordinate with Production, QA, QC, Engineering and EHS for uninterrupted plant operations.

Preferred candidate profile
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical or Chemical Engineering with 10 12 years of relevant experience in utilities operations and maintenance, preferably in API/pharmaceutical manufacturing.
Strong technical knowledge of boilers, chillers, cooling towers, compressors, HVAC, nitrogen and water systems, with exposure to cGMP, EHS and statutory compliance.
Proven ability in team management, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, energy optimization and ensuring uninterrupted utility availability.

Title: Business Development Executive Field sales apprentice role
Location: Patiala / Patran / Jagraun / Ajnala / Batala / Moga / Bathinda
Job Type: Full-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics / Retail / FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
Conduct in-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
Support retail partners with business development strategies and on-ground execution
Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass-out)
Freshers are encouraged to apply
Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
Personal two-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
Work Schedule: 6 days a week
Weekly Off: Sunday
Work Type: Retail store-based with regular local market visits


Benefits
